diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_box_report.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_box_report.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..9cd7db5e9c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_box_report.py
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 box D3-m5: build REPORT.json / REPORT.md for this box's slice (D3.M5 (a)-(e)).
+
+Not a measuring harness: it assembles the box's report from the carried box-D3R
+report (REPORT-D3R.json: rows D3.M1-M4, finding D3-s1-01, already judged and not
+re-reported) and this box's evidence files under state/ (gate_table.jsonl,
+solves-D3-m5*.jsonl, extra_reach.json, m5-*.out, results/matrix/). Every number
+it writes is read from those files or from a harness it runs here
+(m5_matrix.py table); it computes none.
+
+Run: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_box_report.py
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-m5.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ST = HERE / "state"
+REL = "dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1"
+EXTRA = json.loads((HERE / "box_extra.json").read_text())
+
+
+def run(cmd: list[str]) -> str:
+    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, *cmd], capture_output=True, text=True,
+                          env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": "tests/hastub"}).stdout
+
+
+def results(text: str) -> dict:
+    out = {}
+    for ln in text.splitlines():
+        if ln.startswith("RESULT "):
+            k, _, v = ln[7:].partition("=")
+            out[k] = v
+    return out
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    car = json.loads((HERE / "REPORT-D3R.json").read_text())
+    rows = {c["step"]: c for c in car["coverage"]}
+    # Rows this box did not drive: carried as box D3R left them; the
+    # remainder belongs to the other boxes of the split.
+    for step, owner in (("D3.M2", "boxes D3-u1a, D3-u1b, D3-u1c, D3-u1d"),
+                        ("D3.M3", "boxes D3-top6, D3-u1a, D3-u1b, D3-u1c, D3-u1d")):
+        rows[step]["not_reached"] = [f"{x} -- assigned to {owner}, not box D3-m5"
+                                     for x in rows[step]["not_reached"]]
+    scripts = (ST / "m5-scripts-universe.txt").read_text().split("\n")
+    scripts = [s.split("\t")[0] for s in scripts if s.strip()]
+    mt = results(run([f"{REL}/m5_matrix.py", "table"]))
+    m5 = {
+        "step": "D3.M5",
+        "enumerator": f"PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 {REL}/enumerate.py --scripts",
+        "universe": len(scripts),
+        "examined": len(scripts),
+        "not_reached": [],
+        "redispatched": [{"item": i, "state": "examined"} for i in ("C1", "C4", "C7", "C9")],
+        "evidence": EXTRA["m5_evidence"],
+    }
+    rows["D3.M5"] = m5
+    findings = []
+    for p in sorted((HERE / "findings").glob("D3-s1-5*.json")):
+        findings.append(json.loads(p.read_text()))
+    rep = {
+        "dimension": "D3",
+        "baseline_sha": car["baseline_sha"],
+        "report_path": f"{REL}/REPORT.md",
+        "exposure": car["exposure"] + " " + EXTRA["exposure_add"],
+        "coverage": [rows[s] for s in ("D3.M1", "D3.M2", "D3.M3", "D3.M4", "D3.M5")],
+        "unfinished": [],
+        "findings": findings,
+        "non_findings": EXTRA["non_findings"],
+        "harnesses": car["harnesses"] + [f"{REL}/{h}" for h in EXTRA["harnesses_add"]],
+        "leads": EXTRA["leads"],
+    }
+    md = [EXTRA["md_head"], "", "## Coverage", ""]
+    for c in rep["coverage"]:
+        md.append(f"- {c['step']}: universe {c['universe']}, examined {c['examined']}, "
+                  f"not reached {len(c['not_reached'])} item line(s). Enumerator: `{c['enumerator']}`")
+    md += ["", "## D3.M5 evidence (this box)", ""]
+    for e in m5["evidence"]:
+        md.append(f"- `{e['command']}`: {e['value']}")
+    md += ["", "## Findings", ""]
+    md += [f"- {f['id']} ({f['step']}, {f['severity']}): {f['title']}" for f in findings] or \
+          ["- none new on this box; D3-s1-01 (already judged) reproduced, cited not re-reported"]
+    md += ["", "## Non-findings", ""]
+    md += [f"- {n['claim']}: {n['value']} (`{n['command']}`)" for n in rep["non_findings"]]
+    md += ["", "## Leads", ""]
+    md += [f"- {l['owner_seat']} {l['file']} {l['symbol']}: {l['what']}" for l in rep["leads"]]
+    md += ["", "## Redispatched", "", "- D3.M5: C1, C4, C7, C9 examined (box D3-m5)",
+           "", f"Matrix table: {json.dumps(mt)}", ""]
+    rep["report_md"] = "\n".join(md)
+    (HERE / "REPORT.json").write_text(json.dumps(rep, indent=1) + "\n")
+    try:
+        (HERE / "REPORT.md").write_text(rep["report_md"])
+    except OSError as e:
+        print(f"REPORT.md not written: {e}")
+    print(f"RESULT findings={len(findings)}")
+    print(f"RESULT m5_examined={len(scripts)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_card_drift_payload.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_card_drift_payload.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..fb54d3bdad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_card_drift_payload.py
@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5(d)/(e): can a production (cell-file) edit ever move tests/card_drift.mjs?
+
+Metric (one line): states tests/card_drift.mjs reports as moved (`N state(s)
+moved` / `identical in all N states`, plus its exit status), on a payload
+tests/plan_view.py writes from a worktree of HEAD, per arm: `base` (no edit),
+`prod_small`/`prod_large` (one cell-file line edited so the payload's sha256
+differs from base's), `card` (one token of the bundled card's CSS edited).
+card_drift renders the working tree's card and HEAD^1's card against ONE shared
+payload (tests/card_drift.mjs header), so a production edit, which reaches the
+card only through that payload, moves both sides alike.
+
+Instrumented symbol: tests/card_drift.mjs's verdict over tests/plan_view.py's
+payload (production `thermal_model.py` line PROD_LINE executed through
+plan_view's solve); tests/closures.json's card_drift.mjs closure
+(closure.py `_widen` PRODUCERS union) for the edge count.
+Perturbation: the `card` arm (one CSS token in
+custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js) -> moved
+states UP from 0; the `prod_*` arms change the payload sha256 and leave moved
+at 0 (the claim). Also prints card.mjs's verdict per arm: a payload reader
+that is not differential does see payload changes.
+
+Run (repo root): PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_card_drift_payload.py [--select-only]
+Writes only under $TMPDIR (own worktree, private HPO_PLANDATA).
+Expected: base moved=0, prod_small moved=0 payload_changed=1, prod_large
+moved=0 payload_changed=1, card moved>0. Exact counts; seconds provisional.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-m5 (Linux
+x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz), alone on the box.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time as _t
+_P0, _T0 = _t.process_time(), _t.thread_time()
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+PKG = "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/"
+PROD_FILE = PKG + "thermal_model.py"
+PROD_OLD = "        new_room = state.room_temperature + dT_room * dt_hours"
+CARD_FILE = PKG + "www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js"
+CARD_OLD = "      ha-card { padding: 12px 12px 8px 12px; }"
+CARD_NEW = "      ha-card { padding: 13px 12px 8px 12px; }"
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+
+
+def edit(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> str:
+    src = path.read_text()
+    assert src.count(old + "\n") == 1, (path, old)
+    path.write_text(src.replace(old + "\n", new + "\n"))
+    return src
+
+
+def arm(tree: Path, root: Path, name: str) -> dict:
+    plan = root / f"plan-{name}.json"
+    env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": "tests/hastub", "HPO_PLANDATA": str(plan)}
+    t0 = time.monotonic()
+    pv = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tests/plan_view.py"], cwd=tree, env=env,
+                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1200)
+    # stdout to a FILE: node's process.exit(1) truncates a piped stdout
+    # (measured here: a pipe kept 1 of 44 DRIFT lines, a file all 44).
+    with open(root / f"cd-{name}.txt", "w") as fo:
+        rc = subprocess.run(["node", "tests/card_drift.mjs", "HEAD^1"], cwd=tree,
+                            env=env, stdout=fo, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                            timeout=1200).returncode
+    cd = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], rc, (root / f"cd-{name}.txt").read_text(), "")
+    cm = subprocess.run(["node", "tests/card.mjs"], cwd=tree, env=env,
+                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1200)
+    out = cd.stdout
+    # card_drift prints `  DRIFT      <state> (unclaimed)` or `  CLAIMED    <state>`
+    # per moved state and `  identical  <state>` per unmoved one.
+    moved_states = re.findall(r"^  (?:DRIFT|CLAIMED)\s+(\S+)", out, re.M)
+    moved = len(moved_states)
+    ident = len(re.findall(r"^\s*identical\s", out, re.M))
+    cmf = re.search(r"(\d+) CARD CHECK\(S\) FAILED", cm.stdout)
+    sha = hashlib.sha256(plan.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if plan.exists() else "none"
+    return {"arm": name, "plan_view_rc": pv.returncode, "payload_sha256": sha,
+            "card_drift_rc": cd.returncode, "moved": moved, "identical": ident,
+            "card_mjs_rc": cm.returncode, "moved_states": moved_states[:6],
+            "card_drift_head": out[:400],
+            "card_mjs_failed": int(cmf.group(1)) if cmf else 0,
+            "wall_s": round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1),
+            "card_drift_tail": out[-300:]}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if "--select-only" in sys.argv:
+        rows = []
+        return report(rows)
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-carddrift-"))
+    tree = root / "tree"
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet", str(tree),
+                    "HEAD"], cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True)
+    rows = []
+    try:
+        rows.append(arm(tree, root, "base"))
+        for name, new in (("prod_small", PROD_OLD + " * 1.0001"),
+                          ("prod_large", PROD_OLD + " * 1.5")):
+            orig = edit(tree / PROD_FILE, PROD_OLD, new)
+            try:
+                rows.append(arm(tree, root, name))
+            finally:
+                (tree / PROD_FILE).write_text(orig)
+        orig = edit(tree / CARD_FILE, CARD_OLD, CARD_NEW)
+        try:
+            rows.append(arm(tree, root, "card"))
+        finally:
+            (tree / CARD_FILE).write_text(orig)
+    finally:
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", str(tree)],
+                       cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+        shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "prune"], cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+    return report(rows)
+
+
+def report(rows: list) -> int:
+    base_sha = rows[0]["payload_sha256"] if rows else ""
+    for r in rows:
+        r["payload_changed"] = int(r["payload_sha256"] != base_sha)
+        print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "card_drift_tail"}))
+        print(f"RESULT {r['arm']}_moved={r['moved']}")
+        print(f"RESULT {r['arm']}_payload_changed={r['payload_changed']}")
+        print(f"RESULT {r['arm']}_card_drift_rc={r['card_drift_rc']}")
+        print(f"RESULT {r['arm']}_card_mjs_failed={r['card_mjs_failed']}")
+    clos = mt.load_closures().get("tests/card_drift.mjs", [])
+    edges = sum(1 for c in CELLS if PKG + c + ".py" in clos)
+    print(f"RESULT card_drift_cell_closure_edges={edges}")
+    # tests/closure.py:select, the scoped gate's own decision, per one-file
+    # cell diff: how many single-cell-file diffs schedule card_drift.mjs.
+    import closure  # noqa: E402
+    sel = sum(1 for c in CELLS if "tests/card_drift.mjs"
+              in closure.select([PKG + c + ".py"])["run"])
+    print(f"RESULT cell_diffs_selecting_card_drift={sel}")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print(f"RESULT thread_factor={(_t.process_time() - _P0) / max(_t.thread_time() - _T0, 1e-9):.2f}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_closure_reach.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_closure_reach.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..9400245552
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_closure_reach.py
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5: closure over-approximation and per-script cost, from traced baselines.
+
+Metric (one line): for each gate script S whose tests/closures.json closure
+contains cell file F, the number of F's executable lines S's traced unmutated
+run executed (sys.monitoring LINE events, `tests/mutation_table.py:REACH_HOOK`)
+and whether S read F as text; a (S, F) pair with 0 executed lines and no text
+read is an over-approximated closure edge (touching F forces S, S cannot see F).
+Also per-script measured wall vs closures.json `recorded.seconds` (provisional).
+
+Instrumented symbol: tests/closure.py's measured closure (tests/closures.json
+`closures`) against mutation_table:traced_baseline's reach of each cell file.
+Perturbation: delete one cell file's import from a script's traced reach (the
+`--drop FILE` flag zeroes its hits) -> over_approx_pairs goes up by the number
+of scripts that executed it; the identity run is the null control.
+
+Run: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_closure_reach.py [--drop FILE]
+Needs: state/baselines.json written by prescreen.py baseline (same directory).
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: owner macOS arm64, shared.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+RELS = [mt.PKG + c + ".py" for c in CELLS]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    drop = None
+    if "--drop" in sys.argv:
+        drop = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--drop") + 1]
+    base = json.loads((HERE / "state" / "baselines.json").read_text())
+    clos = mt.load_closures()
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    exe = {r: mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / r) for r in RELS}
+    over, pairs, refused = [], 0, []
+    print("script\trc\twall_s\trecorded_s\tratio\treach_ok\tcell_lines_hit")
+    for s in sorted(base):
+        b = base[s]
+        reach = b["reach"]
+        probs = mt.reach_problems(reach)
+        hits_tot = 0
+        for r in RELS:
+            if r not in clos.get(s, ()):
+                continue
+            pairs += 1
+            if probs:
+                continue
+            hits = set(reach["hits"].get(r, ())) & exe[r]
+            if r == drop:
+                hits = set()
+            read = r in reach["reads"]
+            hits_tot += len(hits)
+            if not hits and not read:
+                over.append((s, r))
+        if probs:
+            refused.append((s, probs[0]))
+        w = b["run"]["seconds"]
+        rs = rec.get(s, 0.0)
+        print(f"{s}\t{b['run']['rc']}\t{w:.1f}\t{rs:.1f}\t"
+              f"{(w / rs if rs else 0):.2f}\t{not probs}\t{hits_tot}")
+    print()
+    for s, r in over:
+        print(f"OVER-APPROX {s} -> {r.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]}")
+    for s, p in refused:
+        print(f"REACH-REFUSED {s}: {p}")
+    print(f"RESULT closure_pairs={pairs}")
+    print(f"RESULT over_approx_pairs={len(over)}")
+    print(f"RESULT scripts_reach_refused={len(refused)}")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_envdrift_reach.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_envdrift_reach.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..c17c1e8225
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_envdrift_reach.py
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5: env_drift.py --all is driven on mutants its capture never executes.
+
+Metric (one line): of the unpinned inventory sites in the 12 cell files
+(tests/mutation_table.py:inventory minus dispositions), how many lie on an
+executable line that env_drift.py's production-executing child
+(`env_drift.py --capture <tree> <out> --all`, traced with the gate's own
+REACH_HOOK) never executes -- sites where the gate's reach rule
+(`mutation_table.reach_skip`) still drives env_drift --all, because the
+parent's traced run is refused (`reach_problems`: it starts git/file/uname,
+and the capture child, started with PYTHONPATH reset to tests/hastub, never
+loads the hook, so `processes started > recorded`).
+
+Count key: the delivered reach row -- `reach_skip(<the run's own reach>)`
+must say skippable; a fix that makes the gate's reach of env_drift usable
+moves `gate_skippable` up toward `capture_never_executes`.
+
+Instrumented symbols: tests/mutation_table.py:reach_skip / reach_problems on
+tests/env_drift.py's traced baseline, and env_drift.py:capture_tree's traced
+child run (prescreen.py trace-capture).
+Perturbation: `--as-if-fixed` substitutes the capture child's reach for the
+parent's (what a hook-preserving env_drift would deliver): gate_skippable
+rises from 0 to capture_never_executes (direction up). Null control: the
+same count over sites the capture DOES execute stays 0 skippable under both.
+
+Run: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_envdrift_reach.py [--as-if-fixed]
+Needs state/baselines.json (prescreen.py baseline, then trace-capture).
+Expected: gate_skippable=0 at baseline; exact counts (contention-immune).
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: owner macOS arm64.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import json
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    fixed = "--as-if-fixed" in sys.argv
+    base = json.loads((HERE / "state" / "baselines.json").read_text())
+    ed = base["tests/env_drift.py"]
+    gate_reach = ed["reach"]
+    cap = ed["capture_reach"]
+    assert not mt.reach_problems(cap), mt.reach_problems(cap)
+    budgets = mt.load_budgets()
+    inv = mt.inventory(sorted(mt.PRODUCTION / (c + ".py") for c in CELLS))
+    sites = mt.unpinned_sites(budgets, inv)
+    clos = mt.load_closures()["tests/env_drift.py"]
+    never = gate_skip = exec_skip = executed = 0
+    per = Counter()
+    for m in sites:
+        if m["file"] not in clos:
+            continue
+        cap_never = mt.reach_skip(cap, m)
+        row = cap if fixed else gate_reach
+        skip = mt.reach_skip(row, m)
+        if cap_never:
+            never += 1
+            per[m["file"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]] += 1
+            gate_skip += int(skip)
+        else:
+            executed += 1
+            exec_skip += int(skip)
+    for f, n in sorted(per.items()):
+        print(f"  {f}: {n}")
+    print(f"RESULT unpinned_sites_in_closure={never + executed}")
+    print(f"RESULT capture_never_executes={never}")
+    print(f"RESULT gate_skippable={gate_skip}")
+    print(f"RESULT null_capture_executes={executed}")
+    print(f"RESULT null_skippable={exec_skip}")
+    print(f"RESULT gate_reach_problems={len(mt.reach_problems(gate_reach))}")
+    print(f"RESULT env_drift_baseline_wall_s={ed['run']['seconds']} (provisional)")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_gate_table.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_gate_table.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..053b306775
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_gate_table.py
@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5(a)/(e): the quiet-box gate table -- per closure script, CPU and wall.
+
+Metric (one line): for each gate script whose tests/closures.json closure holds
+a D3-s1 cell file, the wall seconds (time.monotonic) and CPU seconds (the
+child's os.wait4 rusage, utime+stime, which includes every descendant it
+waited for) of ONE gate-shaped invocation, run strictly one at a time
+(GATE_JOBS=1 semantics) in a fresh detached worktree of HEAD, against
+tests/closures.json `recorded.seconds`; ratio = wall / recorded.
+
+Gate shape (tests/run.sh, GOLDEN_MODE unset = strict, GOLDEN_REF=HEAD^1):
+`tests/mutation_table.py:drive_spec` arguments for every .py script
+(env_drift.py `--all HEAD^1`, the drift/mutation-lane form; stress.py with
+GOLDEN_REF in the environment); golden.py with GOLDEN_MODE=strict exported as
+run.sh exports it; the two .mjs run under `node` AFTER their producer
+tests/plan_view.py (closure.py PRODUCERS), which is timed as its own
+`producer:` row and not added to theirs; card_drift.mjs gets HEAD^1. Extra
+arms: `tests/env_drift.py[strict]` = `env_drift.py HEAD^1` (run.sh's strict
+lane form, five fixtures) and `tests/env_drift.py[nocache]` = `--all HEAD^1`
+with DRIFT_NO_CACHE=1 (both captures paid).
+
+Instrumented symbol: tests/closures.json `recorded` (read through
+tests/mutation_table.py:recorded_seconds) against the measured invocation of
+each script; the scripts' own process trees are what is timed.
+Perturbation: `--cpu-burn S` adds a deterministic S-second busy loop to the
+harness's own PYTHONSTARTUP-free wrapper of every .py row (a `-c` prelude
+before runpy), so every .py row's cpu_s and wall_s go UP by about S and the
+.mjs rows stay flat -- the instrument sees cost it is handed. The identity run
+(no flag) is the null control.
+
+Run (repo root): PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_gate_table.py [--scripts a,b] [--out FILE] [--cpu-burn S]
+Writes only under $TMPDIR (worktree, HPO_PLANDATA, logs).
+Expected: every wall/CPU figure is PROVISIONAL (judge re-takes it on a quiet
+container); counts of rows and rc values are exact.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-m5 (Linux
+x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, venv-ci CPython), alone on the box.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import json
+import platform
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+RELS = {mt.PKG + c + ".py" for c in CELLS}
+REF = "HEAD^1"
+
+
+def cell_scripts() -> list[str]:
+    clos = mt.load_closures()
+    return sorted(s for s, fs in clos.items() if any(f in RELS for f in fs))
+
+
+def swapins() -> int:
+    try:
+        for ln in Path("/proc/vmstat").read_text().splitlines():
+            if ln.startswith("pswpin "):
+                return int(ln.split()[1])
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return 0
+
+
+def cpu_model() -> str:
+    try:
+        for ln in Path("/proc/cpuinfo").read_text().splitlines():
+            if ln.startswith("model name"):
+                return ln.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    return platform.processor() or platform.machine()
+
+
+def spec(row: str, burn: float) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], dict]]:
+    """[(label, argv, extra_env)] for one table row (producer first)."""
+    py = sys.executable
+    pre = []
+    if row.endswith(".mjs"):
+        pre.append(("producer:tests/plan_view.py", [py, "tests/plan_view.py"], {}))
+        args = [REF] if row == "tests/card_drift.mjs" else []
+        return pre + [(row, ["node", row, *args], {})]
+    script, arm = row, ""
+    if "[" in row:
+        script, arm = row[:-1].split("[")
+    args, env = mt.drive_spec(script, REF)
+    env = dict(env)
+    if script == "tests/golden.py":
+        env.update(GOLDEN_MODE="strict", GOLDEN_REF=REF)
+    if arm == "strict":
+        args = [REF]
+    if arm == "nocache":
+        env["DRIFT_NO_CACHE"] = "1"
+    argv = [py, script, *args]
+    if burn:
+        prelude = (f"import time,runpy,sys;t=time.process_time()\n"
+                   f"while time.process_time()-t<{burn}: pass\n"
+                   f"sys.argv={[script, *args]!r};runpy.run_path({script!r},run_name='__main__')")
+        argv = [py, "-c", prelude]
+    return [(row, argv, env)]
+
+
+def run_one(argv, env, cwd: Path, log: Path) -> dict:
+    with open(log, "w") as fo:
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        p = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=fo,
+                             stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        _, status, ru = os.wait4(p.pid, 0)
+        wall = time.monotonic() - t0
+    p.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
+    return {"rc": p.returncode, "wall_s": round(wall, 1),
+            "cpu_s": round(ru.ru_utime + ru.ru_stime, 1),
+            "maxrss_mb": round(ru.ru_maxrss / 1024, 1)}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--scripts")
+    ap.add_argument("--out")
+    ap.add_argument("--cpu-burn", type=float, default=0.0)
+    ap.add_argument("--keep-tree", action="store_true")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    rows = (a.scripts.split(",") if a.scripts else
+            cell_scripts() + ["tests/env_drift.py[strict]",
+                              "tests/env_drift.py[nocache]"])
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-gatetable-"))
+    tree = root / "tree"
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet", str(tree),
+                    "HEAD"], cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True)
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    base_env = {**os.environ,
+                "PYTHONPATH": str(tree / "tests" / "hastub"),
+                "HPO_PLANDATA": str(root / "plandata"),
+                "GOLDEN_REF": REF}
+    base_env.pop("HPO_REACH_HOOK", None)
+    nproc = os.cpu_count()
+    cpu = cpu_model()
+    print(f"# nproc={nproc} cpu={cpu!r} python={platform.python_version()} "
+          f"tree={tree}")
+    print("script\trc\twall_s\tcpu_s\tcpu/wall\tmaxrss_mb\trecorded_s\t"
+          "wall/recorded\tload1_before\tload1_after")
+    t_proc0, t_thr0 = time.process_time(), time.thread_time()
+    sw0 = swapins()
+    try:
+        for row in rows:
+            for label, argv, extra in spec(row, a.cpu_burn):
+                env = {**base_env, **extra}
+                l0 = os.getloadavg()[0]
+                r = run_one(argv, env, tree,
+                            root / (label.replace("/", "_").replace(":", "_") + ".log"))
+                l1 = os.getloadavg()[0]
+                script = label.split("[")[0].split(":")[-1]
+                rs = rec.get(script) if not label.startswith("producer:") else rec.get(script)
+                ratio = (r["wall_s"] / rs) if rs else None
+                rowd = {"script": label, **r, "recorded_s": rs,
+                        "wall_over_recorded": round(ratio, 2) if ratio else None,
+                        "cpu_over_wall": round(r["cpu_s"] / r["wall_s"], 2) if r["wall_s"] else None,
+                        "load1_before": round(l0, 2), "load1_after": round(l1, 2),
+                        "nproc": nproc, "cpu_model": cpu,
+                        "cpu_burn": a.cpu_burn, "provisional": True,
+                        "log_tail": (root / (label.replace("/", "_").replace(":", "_") + ".log")).read_text(errors="replace")[-600:]}
+                print(f"{label}\t{r['rc']}\t{r['wall_s']}\t{r['cpu_s']}\t"
+                      f"{rowd['cpu_over_wall']}\t{r['maxrss_mb']}\t{rs}\t"
+                      f"{rowd['wall_over_recorded']}\t{l0:.2f}\t{l1:.2f}", flush=True)
+                if a.out:
+                    with open(a.out, "a") as f:
+                        f.write(json.dumps(rowd) + "\n")
+                key = label.replace("producer:", "producer_").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+                key = key.replace(".py", "").replace(".mjs", "_mjs").replace("[", "_").replace("]", "")
+                print(f"RESULT {key}_wall_s={r['wall_s']} s (provisional)")
+                print(f"RESULT {key}_cpu_s={r['cpu_s']} s (provisional)")
+                print(f"RESULT {key}_rc={r['rc']}")
+    finally:
+        if not a.keep_tree:
+            subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", str(tree)],
+                           cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+            shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
+            subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "prune"], cwd=mt.ROOT,
+                           capture_output=True)
+    tf = (time.process_time() - t_proc0) / max(time.thread_time() - t_thr0, 1e-9)
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print(f"RESULT thread_factor={tf:.2f}")
+    print(f"RESULT swapins={swapins() - sw0}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_matrix.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_matrix.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..81cea2bbb3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_matrix.py
@@ -0,0 +1,202 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5(b): the kill-overlap matrix -- every closure script x every mutant.
+
+Metric (one line): for each (mutant, closure script of the mutant's file)
+pair, the verdict of that script on that mutant with no early stop -- K
+killed (`tests/mutation_table.py:killed`: red AND more failing checks than the
+traced unmutated baseline), S ran and survived, R reach-skipped (the script's
+clean traced baseline never executed the mutated line,
+`mutation_table:reach_skip`, so it cannot kill), T timed out; per script its
+kills, its UNIQUE kills (mutants no other script kills) and per mutant its
+killer count; duplicate kills = sum over killed mutants of (killers - 1).
+
+Mutant set (`build`): every mutant of c2_mutants.json and c3c6_mutants.json,
+plus every SURVIVED verdict under state/results/{pre,c2,c3c6}/, de-duplicated
+by prescreen.py's key -> matrix_mutants.json. The drives themselves are
+prescreen.py's (`run --full --mutants matrix_mutants.json --sub matrix...`,
+D3S1_RELAX=0, so only the gate's own reach rule skips a pair).
+
+golden.py (driven in run.sh's default strict mode) prints `N of M GOLDEN
+SCENARIOS CHANGED`, which mutation_table.failing_count does not read: its
+column is re-judged here on that count against its own baseline's.
+tests/stress.py's column is driven alone afterwards (`--sub matrix-stress`,
+one worker), as the brief's quiet-window rule requires.
+
+Instrumented symbol: tests/mutation_table.py:killed / reach_skip over
+prescreen.py:drive's per-driver runs of each mutated production line.
+Perturbation: `--drop SCRIPT` removes one script's column -> `survivors`
+rises by exactly that script's unique kills (direction up) and
+`duplicate_kills` falls by its non-unique kills; dropping a script with no
+unique kill leaves `survivors` unchanged (the null control).
+
+Run (repo root):
+  PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_matrix.py build
+  PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_matrix.py table [--drop SCRIPT] [--subs matrix,matrix-extra,matrix-stress]
+Expected: exact counts (contention-immune); seconds columns provisional.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-m5 (Linux
+x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz), alone on the box.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import re
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+import time as _t
+_P0, _T0 = _t.process_time(), _t.thread_time()
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RESULTS = HERE / "state" / "results"
+
+
+def key(m: dict) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha1((m["anchor"] + "|" + m["new"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def label(m: dict) -> str:
+    tag = m.get("c2_id") or m.get("r10_id") or m["kind"]
+    return f"{m['file'].rsplit('/', 1)[-1]}:{m['line']} {tag}"
+
+
+def cmd_build(_a) -> int:
+    allm: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    for f in ("c2_mutants.json", "c3c6_mutants.json"):
+        for m in json.loads((HERE / f).read_text()):
+            allm.setdefault(key(m), m)
+    for sub in ("pre", "c2", "c3c6"):
+        for p in sorted((RESULTS / sub).glob("*.json")):
+            r = json.loads(p.read_text())
+            if r["verdict"] == "SURVIVED":
+                allm.setdefault(key(r["mutant"]), r["mutant"])
+    out = sorted(allm.values(), key=lambda m: (m["file"], m["line"], m["new"]))
+    (HERE / "matrix_mutants.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
+    print(f"RESULT matrix_mutants={len(out)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+GOLDEN_CHANGED = re.compile(r"(\d+) of (\d+) GOLDEN SCENARIOS CHANGED")
+
+
+def golden_count(stdout: str, stderr: str) -> int:
+    """golden.py strict prints `N of M GOLDEN SCENARIOS CHANGED`, a form
+    mutation_table.failing_count does not read (golden.py is one of its
+    DRIVER_EXCLUSIONS); a traceback adds one, as failing_count does."""
+    m = GOLDEN_CHANGED.findall(stdout)
+    return (int(m[-1][0]) if m else 0) + int("Traceback (most recent call last):" in stderr)
+
+
+def golden_base() -> int | None:
+    b = json.loads((HERE / "state" / "baselines.json").read_text()).get("tests/golden.py")
+    if not b:
+        return None
+    return golden_count(b["run"].get("stdout_tail", ""), b["run"].get("stderr_tail", ""))
+
+
+def load(subs: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    """key -> {mutant, cells: {script: verdict}, secs: {script: s}}."""
+    rows: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    gb = golden_base()
+    for sub in subs:
+        d = RESULTS / sub
+        if not d.exists():
+            continue
+        for p in sorted(d.glob("*.json")):
+            r = json.loads(p.read_text())
+            row = rows.setdefault(p.stem, {"mutant": r["mutant"], "cells": {},
+                                           "secs": {}})
+            for s in r.get("skipped", []):
+                row["cells"].setdefault(s, "R")
+            for s in r.get("relaxed_skipped", []):
+                row["cells"].setdefault(s, "X")
+            for s, j in r["runs"].items():
+                k = j.get("killed")
+                if s == "tests/golden.py" and gb is not None and not j.get("timed_out"):
+                    # re-judged on golden's own verdict form (kill = red AND
+                    # more scenarios changed than the unmutated baseline's)
+                    k = j["rc"] != 0 and golden_count(
+                        j.get("stdout_tail", ""), j.get("stderr_tail", "")) > gb
+                row["cells"][s] = ("K" if k else
+                                   "T" if j.get("timed_out") else "S")
+                row["secs"][s] = j.get("seconds", 0.0)
+    return rows
+
+
+def cmd_table(a) -> int:
+    subs = a.subs.split(",")
+    rows = load(subs)
+    want = json.loads((HERE / "matrix_mutants.json").read_text())
+    wk = {key(m) for m in want}
+    rows = {k: v for k, v in rows.items() if k in wk}
+    drop = set(a.drop.split(",")) if a.drop else set()
+    scripts = sorted({s for r in rows.values() for s in r["cells"]} - drop)
+    kills, uniq, ran, secs = Counter(), Counter(), Counter(), defaultdict(float)
+    reach_skipped, timeouts = Counter(), Counter()
+    survivors, dup, killed_mut = 0, 0, 0
+    per_killers = Counter()
+    pairs = Counter()
+    for k, r in sorted(rows.items(), key=lambda kv: label(kv[1]["mutant"])):
+        cells = {s: v for s, v in r["cells"].items() if s not in drop}
+        ks = sorted(s for s, v in cells.items() if v == "K")
+        for s, v in cells.items():
+            pairs[v] += 1
+            if v in "KST":
+                ran[s] += 1
+                secs[s] += r["secs"].get(s, 0.0)
+            if v == "R":
+                reach_skipped[s] += 1
+            if v == "T":
+                timeouts[s] += 1
+        for s in ks:
+            kills[s] += 1
+        if len(ks) == 1:
+            uniq[ks[0]] += 1
+        if ks:
+            killed_mut += 1
+            dup += len(ks) - 1
+        else:
+            survivors += 1
+        per_killers[len(ks)] += 1
+        if a.verbose:
+            print(f"{label(r['mutant'])}\tkillers={','.join(s.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] for s in ks) or '-'}\t"
+                  + " ".join(f"{s.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]}={v}" for s, v in sorted(cells.items())))
+    print("\nscript\tran\treach_skipped\ttimeouts\tkills\tunique_kills\tsum_seconds(provisional)")
+    for s in scripts:
+        print(f"{s}\t{ran[s]}\t{reach_skipped[s]}\t{timeouts[s]}\t{kills[s]}\t{uniq[s]}\t{secs[s]:.0f}")
+    no_unique = [s for s in scripts if uniq[s] == 0]
+    for s in no_unique:
+        print(f"NO-UNIQUE-KILL {s} ran={ran[s]} kills={kills[s]} seconds={secs[s]:.0f}")
+    print(f"RESULT mutants={len(rows)}")
+    print(f"RESULT pairs={sum(pairs.values())}")
+    for v in "KSRTX":
+        print(f"RESULT pairs_{v}={pairs[v]}")
+    print(f"RESULT killed_mutants={killed_mut}")
+    print(f"RESULT survivors={survivors}")
+    print(f"RESULT duplicate_kills={dup}")
+    for n in sorted(per_killers):
+        print(f"RESULT mutants_with_{n}_killers={per_killers[n]}")
+    print(f"RESULT scripts_without_unique_kill={len(no_unique)}")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print(f"RESULT thread_factor={(_t.process_time() - _P0) / max(_t.thread_time() - _T0, 1e-9):.2f}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=("build", "table"))
+    ap.add_argument("--drop")
+    ap.add_argument("--subs", default="matrix,matrix-extra,matrix-stress")
+    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    return {"build": cmd_build, "table": cmd_table}[a.cmd](a)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5: checks per solve, per gate script whose closure reaches the cells.
+
+Metric (one line): solves = calls of
+`custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize`
+summed over every Python process the script starts (a sitecustomize hook
+wraps the method when the module finishes executing, counts persist per pid);
+checks = the script's own closing tally (`N of M` / `ALL N ... PASSED`);
+ratio = checks / solves. Also `_multi_start_minimize` calls (inner L-BFGS-B
+multi-starts) and process CPU seconds of the run (provisional).
+
+Instrumented symbol: optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (and
+optimizer:_multi_start_minimize).
+Perturbation: `--double-solve` makes the hook call the original optimize twice
+per call (same result returned) -> solves for every script doubles (direction
+up) and checks stay flat, so checks_per_solve halves; identity run = null.
+
+Run: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_solves.py [--scripts a,b] [--double-solve]
+Writes only under a mkdtemp root and its own worker tree under $TMPDIR.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: owner macOS arm64, shared box.
+Expected: exact counts (contention-immune); CPU seconds provisional.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import resource
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+HOOK = r'''
+import os, sys, atexit, importlib.abc, importlib.machinery
+_OUT = os.environ.get("D3S1_SOLVE_OUT")
+_DOUBLE = os.environ.get("D3S1_DOUBLE") == "1"
+_C = {"optimize": 0, "multi_start": 0}
+def _dump():
+    if _OUT:
+        with open(os.path.join(_OUT, f"{os.getpid()}.json"), "w") as f:
+            import json; json.dump(_C, f)
+atexit.register(_dump)
+def _patch(mod):
+    cls = getattr(mod, "HeatPumpOptimizer", None)
+    if cls is not None and not getattr(cls.optimize, "_d3s1", False):
+        orig = cls.optimize
+        def optimize(self, *a, **k):
+            _C["optimize"] += 1
+            if _DOUBLE:
+                _C["optimize"] += 1
+                orig(self, *a, **k)
+            return orig(self, *a, **k)
+        optimize._d3s1 = True
+        cls.optimize = optimize
+    ms = getattr(mod, "_multi_start_minimize", None)
+    if ms is not None and not getattr(ms, "_d3s1", False):
+        def _ms(*a, **k):
+            _C["multi_start"] += 1
+            return ms(*a, **k)
+        _ms._d3s1 = True
+        mod._multi_start_minimize = _ms
+class _L(importlib.abc.Loader):
+    def __init__(self, inner): self.inner = inner
+    def create_module(self, spec): return self.inner.create_module(spec)
+    def exec_module(self, module):
+        self.inner.exec_module(module); _patch(module)
+class _F(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
+    def find_spec(self, name, path, target=None):
+        if not name.endswith("optimizer") or name.endswith("_optimizer"):
+            return None
+        for f in sys.meta_path:
+            if f is self: continue
+            fs = getattr(f, "find_spec", None)
+            if fs is None: continue
+            spec = fs(name, path, target)
+            if spec is not None:
+                if spec.origin and spec.origin.endswith(os.path.join("heatpump_optimizer", "optimizer.py")):
+                    spec.loader = _L(spec.loader)
+                return spec
+        return None
+sys.meta_path.insert(0, _F())
+'''
+
+TALLY = [re.compile(r"(\d+) of (\d+) .*FAILED"),
+         re.compile(r"ALL (\d+) .*PASSED"),
+         re.compile(r"(\d+)/(\d+) .*(?:passed|ok)", re.I)]
+
+
+def tally(out: str):
+    m = None
+    for m in TALLY[0].finditer(out):
+        pass
+    if m:
+        return int(m.group(2))
+    for m in TALLY[1].finditer(out):
+        pass
+    if m:
+        return int(m.group(1))
+    n = len(re.findall(r"^\s*(?:ok|FAIL)\s", out, re.M))
+    return n or None
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--scripts")
+    ap.add_argument("--double-solve", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--tree", default=str(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "d3s1-workers" / "w5"))
+    ap.add_argument("--out", help="append JSON lines here")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    if a.scripts:
+        scripts = a.scripts.split(",")
+    else:
+        base = json.loads((here / "state" / "baselines.json").read_text())
+        scripts = sorted(base)
+    t = Path(a.tree)
+    if not (t / ".git").exists():
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet", str(t), "HEAD"],
+                       cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True)
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-solves-"))
+    hook = root / "_hook"
+    hook.mkdir()
+    (hook / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(HOOK)
+    for s in scripts:
+        out = root / s.replace("/", "_")
+        out.mkdir()
+        args, env = mt.drive_spec(s, "HEAD^1")
+        env = {**os.environ, **env, "PYTHONPATH": f"{hook}{os.pathsep}tests/hastub",
+               "D3S1_SOLVE_OUT": str(out), "D3S1_DOUBLE": "1" if a.double_solve else "0"}
+        r0 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, s, *args], cwd=t, env=env,
+                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=7200)
+        wall = time.monotonic() - t0
+        r1 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+        cpu = (r1.ru_utime + r1.ru_stime) - (r0.ru_utime + r0.ru_stime)
+        opt = ms = procs = 0
+        for f in out.glob("*.json"):
+            d = json.loads(f.read_text())
+            opt += d["optimize"]
+            ms += d["multi_start"]
+            procs += 1
+        checks = tally(p.stdout)
+        row = {"script": s, "rc": p.returncode, "checks": checks, "solves": opt,
+               "multi_starts": ms, "procs_recorded": procs,
+               "cpu_s": round(cpu, 1), "wall_s": round(wall, 1),
+               "checks_per_solve": (round(checks / opt, 3) if checks and opt else None)}
+        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
+        if a.out:
+            with open(a.out, "a") as f:
+                f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
+        key = s.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].replace(".py", "")
+        print(f"RESULT {key}_solves={opt}")
+        print(f"RESULT {key}_checks={checks}")
+        print(f"RESULT {key}_cpu_s={cpu:.1f} s (provisional)")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5: checks per solve, per gate script whose closure reaches the cells.
+
+Metric (one line): solves = calls of
+`custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize`
+summed over every Python process the script starts (a sitecustomize hook
+wraps the method when the module finishes executing, counts persist per pid);
+checks = the script's own closing tally (`N of M` / `ALL N ... PASSED`);
+ratio = checks / solves. Also `_multi_start_minimize` calls (inner L-BFGS-B
+multi-starts) and process CPU seconds of the run (provisional).
+
+Instrumented symbol: optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (and
+optimizer:_multi_start_minimize).
+Perturbation: `--double-solve` makes the hook call the original optimize twice
+per call (same result returned) -> solves for every script doubles (direction
+up) and checks stay flat, so checks_per_solve halves; identity run = null.
+
+Box D3-m5 (D3.M5(c)): `--hastub-hook` for the ref-driven drivers
+(tests/env_drift.py, tests/stress.py), whose production-executing children
+are started with PYTHONPATH rebuilt to `<tree>/tests/hastub` (tests/env_drift.py
+capture loop; tests/stress.py capture_work_rows / capture_calls_pair), which
+drops a PYTHONPATH-prepended hook. The hook is written as
+`tests/hastub/sitecustomize.py` into the worker tree (untracked) AND into a
+synthetic comparison commit = HEAD^1's tree + that one file (production
+byte-identical to HEAD^1), passed as the ref, so both sides' children count.
+A synthetic ref misses env_drift's baseline cache, so env_drift's row is the
+COLD cost (both captures); `--warm-split` also prints the tree-side share.
+
+Run: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_solves.py [--scripts a,b] [--double-solve] [--hastub-hook]
+Writes only under a mkdtemp root and its own worker tree under $TMPDIR.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: owner macOS arm64, shared box.
+Expected: exact counts (contention-immune); CPU seconds provisional.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import resource
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+HOOK = r'''
+import os, sys, atexit, importlib.abc, importlib.machinery
+_OUT = os.environ.get("D3S1_SOLVE_OUT")
+_DOUBLE = os.environ.get("D3S1_DOUBLE") == "1"
+_C = {"optimize": 0, "multi_start": 0}
+def _dump():
+    if _OUT:
+        with open(os.path.join(_OUT, f"{os.getpid()}.json"), "w") as f:
+            import json; json.dump(_C, f)
+atexit.register(_dump)
+def _patch(mod):
+    cls = getattr(mod, "HeatPumpOptimizer", None)
+    if cls is not None and not getattr(cls.optimize, "_d3s1", False):
+        orig = cls.optimize
+        def optimize(self, *a, **k):
+            _C["optimize"] += 1
+            if _DOUBLE:
+                _C["optimize"] += 1
+                orig(self, *a, **k)
+            return orig(self, *a, **k)
+        optimize._d3s1 = True
+        cls.optimize = optimize
+    ms = getattr(mod, "_multi_start_minimize", None)
+    if ms is not None and not getattr(ms, "_d3s1", False):
+        def _ms(*a, **k):
+            _C["multi_start"] += 1
+            return ms(*a, **k)
+        _ms._d3s1 = True
+        mod._multi_start_minimize = _ms
+class _L(importlib.abc.Loader):
+    def __init__(self, inner): self.inner = inner
+    def create_module(self, spec): return self.inner.create_module(spec)
+    def exec_module(self, module):
+        self.inner.exec_module(module); _patch(module)
+class _F(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
+    def find_spec(self, name, path, target=None):
+        if not name.endswith("optimizer") or name.endswith("_optimizer"):
+            return None
+        for f in sys.meta_path:
+            if f is self: continue
+            fs = getattr(f, "find_spec", None)
+            if fs is None: continue
+            spec = fs(name, path, target)
+            if spec is not None:
+                if spec.origin and spec.origin.endswith(os.path.join("heatpump_optimizer", "optimizer.py")):
+                    spec.loader = _L(spec.loader)
+                return spec
+        return None
+sys.meta_path.insert(0, _F())
+'''
+
+TALLY = [re.compile(r"(\d+) of (\d+) .*FAILED"),
+         re.compile(r"ALL (\d+) .*PASSED"),
+         re.compile(r"(\d+)/(\d+) .*(?:passed|ok)", re.I)]
+
+
+def tally(out: str):
+    # tests/env_drift.py prints no harness tally: its checks are the scenarios
+    # it compares against the ref plus the committed fixtures it re-checks.
+    sc = re.findall(r"(\d+) scenario\(s\) checked", out)
+    fx = re.findall(r"(\d+) committed fixture\(s\)", out)
+    if sc:
+        return int(sc[-1]) + (int(fx[-1]) if fx else 0)
+    m = None
+    for m in TALLY[0].finditer(out):
+        pass
+    if m:
+        return int(m.group(2))
+    for m in TALLY[1].finditer(out):
+        pass
+    if m:
+        return int(m.group(1))
+    n = len(re.findall(r"^\s*(?:ok|FAIL)\s", out, re.M))
+    return n or None
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--scripts")
+    ap.add_argument("--double-solve", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--tree", default=str(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "d3s1-workers" / "w5"))
+    ap.add_argument("--out", help="append JSON lines here")
+    ap.add_argument("--hastub-hook", action="store_true")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    if a.scripts:
+        scripts = a.scripts.split(",")
+    else:
+        base = json.loads((here / "state" / "baselines.json").read_text())
+        scripts = sorted(base)
+    t = Path(a.tree)
+    if not (t / ".git").exists():
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet", str(t), "HEAD"],
+                       cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True)
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-solves-"))
+    hook = root / "_hook"
+    hook.mkdir()
+    (hook / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(HOOK)
+    ref = "HEAD^1"
+    if a.hastub_hook:
+        (t / "tests" / "hastub" / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(HOOK)
+        g = lambda *c, **k: subprocess.run(["git", *c], cwd=t, capture_output=True,
+                                            text=True, check=True, **k).stdout.strip()
+        blob = g("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", input=HOOK)
+        idx = root / "idx"
+        env_i = {**os.environ, "GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(idx)}
+        subprocess.run(["git", "read-tree", "HEAD^1"], cwd=t, env=env_i, check=True)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "update-index", "--add", "--cacheinfo",
+                        f"100644,{blob},tests/hastub/sitecustomize.py"], cwd=t,
+                       env=env_i, check=True)
+        tree_sha = subprocess.run(["git", "write-tree"], cwd=t, env=env_i,
+                                  capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
+        ref = subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.name=d3s1", "-c", "user.email=d3s1@invalid",
+                              "commit-tree", tree_sha, "-p", g("rev-parse", "HEAD^1"),
+                              "-m", "d3s1 solve-count ref: HEAD^1 + hastub hook"],
+                             cwd=t, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
+        print(f"# synthetic ref {ref} (HEAD^1 + tests/hastub/sitecustomize.py)")
+    for s in scripts:
+        out = root / s.replace("/", "_")
+        out.mkdir()
+        args, env = mt.drive_spec(s, ref)
+        pp = "tests/hastub" if a.hastub_hook else f"{hook}{os.pathsep}tests/hastub"
+        env = {**os.environ, **env, "PYTHONPATH": pp,
+               "D3S1_SOLVE_OUT": str(out), "D3S1_DOUBLE": "1" if a.double_solve else "0"}
+        r0 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, s, *args], cwd=t, env=env,
+                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=14400)
+        wall = time.monotonic() - t0
+        r1 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+        cpu = (r1.ru_utime + r1.ru_stime) - (r0.ru_utime + r0.ru_stime)
+        opt = ms = procs = 0
+        for f in out.glob("*.json"):
+            d = json.loads(f.read_text())
+            opt += d["optimize"]
+            ms += d["multi_start"]
+            procs += 1
+        checks = tally(p.stdout)
+        row = {"script": s, "rc": p.returncode, "checks": checks, "solves": opt,
+               "ref": ref, "hastub_hook": a.hastub_hook,
+               "per_proc": sorted((json.loads(f.read_text())["optimize"] for f in out.glob("*.json")), reverse=True)[:12],
+               "stdout_tail": p.stdout[-800:],
+               "multi_starts": ms, "procs_recorded": procs,
+               "cpu_s": round(cpu, 1), "wall_s": round(wall, 1),
+               "checks_per_solve": (round(checks / opt, 3) if checks and opt else None)}
+        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
+        if a.out:
+            with open(a.out, "a") as f:
+                f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
+        key = s.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].replace(".py", "")
+        print(f"RESULT {key}_solves={opt}")
+        print(f"RESULT {key}_checks={checks}")
+        print(f"RESULT {key}_cpu_s={cpu:.1f} s (provisional)")
+    if a.hastub_hook:
+        (t / "tests" / "hastub" / "sitecustomize.py").unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_extra.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_extra.py

index 0000000000..0eaf9a65d1

@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5(d)(e): trace the closure scripts the pre-screen never drove, and test their closures.
+
+Metric (one line): for each script S (default tests/stress.py, tests/golden.py,
+tests/card.mjs, tests/card_drift.mjs, plus tests/boost_drift_replay.py read
+from state/baselines.json), and each D3-s1 cell file F in S's
+tests/closures.json closure: the number of F's executable lines S's unmutated
+run executes (sys.monitoring LINE events of mutation_table:REACH_HOOK, every
+Python process S starts) and whether S reads F as text; a pair (S, F) with
+0 executed lines, no text read and a usable reach row (reach_problems empty)
+is an OVER-APPROXIMATED closure edge: a diff touching F forces S, S cannot
+see F. A Node program (card.mjs, card_drift.mjs) starts no Python process; it
+renders the payload tests/plan_view.py writes (tests/closure.py PRODUCERS), so
+its cell edges are judged by plan_view.py's traced reach (`via-producer`). Count key: the hits the traced run delivers, never the closure list.
+
+Instrumented symbols: tests/mutation_table.py:REACH_HOOK / collect /
+reach_problems on each traced run; tests/closures.json `closures` (the
+measured closure tests/closure.py selects from).
+Perturbation: `--drop FILE` zeroes FILE's hits in every row -> over_approx
+pairs rise by the number of rows that executed FILE (direction up); the
+identity run is the null control.
+
+Run: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_extra.py trace [--scripts a,b]   # runs, writes state/extra_reach.json
+     PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_extra.py table [--drop FILE]    # reads it
+Invocation as tests/run.sh: stress.py with GOLDEN_REF=HEAD^1 exported,
+card_drift.mjs HEAD^1, card.mjs bare (all after plan_view.py wrote the
+payload to a private HPO_PLANDATA), golden.py under GOLDEN_MODE=strict (the
+mode in which run.sh runs it; under drift run.sh skips it).
+Expected: exact counts; wall/CPU provisional.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692.
+Machine: box D3-m5, Linux x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.30GHz.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import json
+import resource
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+OUT = HERE / "state" / "extra_reach.json"
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+RELS = [mt.PKG + c + ".py" for c in CELLS]
+DEFAULT = ["tests/plan_view.py", "tests/card.mjs", "tests/card_drift.mjs",
+           "tests/golden.py", "tests/stress.py"]
+REF = "HEAD^1"
+
+
+def invocation(s: str, plan: Path):
+    env = {"HPO_PLANDATA": str(plan), "GOLDEN_REF": REF}
+    if s == "tests/card.mjs":
+        return ["node", s], env
+    if s == "tests/card_drift.mjs":
+        return ["node", s, REF], env
+    if s == "tests/golden.py":
+        return [sys.executable, s], {**env, "GOLDEN_MODE": "strict"}
+    a, e = mt.drive_spec(s, REF)
+    return [sys.executable, s, *a], {**env, **e}
+
+
+def trace(scripts: list[str]) -> int:
+    t = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "d3s1-workers" / "tx"
+    if not (t / ".git").exists():
+        t.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet", str(t), "HEAD"],
+                       cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True)
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-tx-"))
+    plan = root / "plandata.json"
+    cur = json.loads(OUT.read_text()) if OUT.exists() else {}
+    for s in scripts:
+        out = root / ("reach-" + s.replace("/", "_"))
+        out.mkdir()
+        env = mt.hook_env(out)
+        cmd, extra = invocation(s, plan)
+        full = {**os.environ, **extra, **env,
+                "PYTHONPATH": mt.traced_pythonpath(env, "tests/hastub")}
+        r0 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=t, env=full, capture_output=True, text=True,
+                           timeout=7200)
+        wall = time.monotonic() - t0
+        r1 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+        cpu = (r1.ru_utime + r1.ru_stime) - (r0.ru_utime + r0.ru_stime)
+        reach = mt.collect(out)
+        if cmd[0] == "node":
+            # collect() counts the root as one started Python process; a Node
+            # root is not one, so the started count is one too high.
+            reach["processes"]["started"] -= 1
+            reach["root"] = "node"
+        reach["rc"] = p.returncode
+        run = mt.ScriptRun(p.returncode, 0, wall, p.stdout, p.stderr)
+        cur[s] = {"rc": p.returncode, "failed": mt.failing_count(run),
+                  "wall_s": round(wall, 1), "cpu_s": round(cpu, 1),
+                  "traced": True, "provisional": True,
+                  "load1": round(os.getloadavg()[0], 2),
+                  "stdout_tail": p.stdout[-1200:], "stderr_tail": p.stderr[-800:],
+                  "reach": reach, "reach_problems": mt.reach_problems(reach)}
+        OUT.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+        print(f"TRACED {s} rc={p.returncode} wall={wall:.1f}s cpu={cpu:.1f}s "
+              f"procs={reach['processes']} problems={cur[s]['reach_problems']}", flush=True)
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return 0
+
+
+def table(drop: str | None) -> int:
+    cur = json.loads(OUT.read_text())
+    base = json.loads((HERE / "state" / "baselines.json").read_text())
+    if "tests/boost_drift_replay.py" in base:
+        b = base["tests/boost_drift_replay.py"]
+        cur["tests/boost_drift_replay.py"] = {
+            "rc": b["run"]["rc"], "wall_s": b["run"]["seconds"], "cpu_s": None,
+            "reach": b["reach"], "reach_problems": mt.reach_problems(b["reach"])}
+    clos = mt.load_closures()
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    exe = {r: mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / r) for r in RELS}
+    over = pairs = 0
+    print("script\tcell\tin_closure\texec_lines\tof_executable\tread_as_text\tverdict")
+    for s in sorted(cur):
+        if s == "tests/plan_view.py":
+            continue
+        row = cur[s]
+        reach = row["reach"]
+        probs = row["reach_problems"]
+        via = ""
+        if s.endswith(".mjs") and "tests/plan_view.py" in cur:
+            # A Node program starts no Python: it renders the payload
+            # plan_view.py writes (closure.py PRODUCERS). Its cell edges are
+            # judged by what its producer's traced run executes.
+            reach = cur["tests/plan_view.py"]["reach"]
+            probs = cur["tests/plan_view.py"]["reach_problems"]
+            via = "via-producer:plan_view.py:"
+        for r in RELS:
+            if r not in clos.get(s, ()):
+                continue
+            pairs += 1
+            hits = set((reach or {}).get("hits", {}).get(r, ())) & exe[r]
+            if r == drop:
+                hits = set()
+            read = r in (reach or {}).get("reads", ())
+            if probs:
+                v = "refused:" + probs[0]
+            elif not hits and not read:
+                v = "OVER-APPROX"
+                over += 1
+            else:
+                v = "reached"
+            v = via + v
+            print(f"{s}\t{r.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]}\t1\t{len(hits)}\t{len(exe[r])}\t{read}\t{v}")
+        print(f"COST {s} rc={row['rc']} wall_s={row['wall_s']} cpu_s={row['cpu_s']} "
+              f"recorded_s={rec.get(s)} (provisional)")
+    print(f"RESULT closure_pairs={pairs}")
+    print(f"RESULT over_approx_pairs={over}")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=("trace", "table"))
+    ap.add_argument("--scripts")
+    ap.add_argument("--drop")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    if a.cmd == "trace":
+        return trace(a.scripts.split(",") if a.scripts else DEFAULT)
+    return table(a.drop)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_hastub.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_hastub.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..ca5df213ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_hastub.py
@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 M5(d)/(e): which cell lines a gate script REALLY executes, children included.
+
+Metric (one line): per script S and per D3-s1 cell file F in S's
+tests/closures.json closure, the number of F's executable lines that any
+Python process of S's gate-shaped run executed (sys.monitoring LINE events,
+tests/mutation_table.py:REACH_HOOK), and whether S read F as text; a pair
+with 0 executed lines and no read is an over-approximated closure edge.
+
+Why a second tracer: tests/env_drift.py and tests/stress.py start their
+production-executing children with PYTHONPATH rebuilt to `<tree>/tests/hastub`,
+which drops mutation_table's PYTHONPATH-prepended hook (the processes are
+counted but leave no record; D3-s1-01 judged that for env_drift). Here the
+hook is written as `tests/hastub/sitecustomize.py` in a fresh worktree of HEAD
+(untracked) AND in a synthetic comparison commit = HEAD^1's tree + that file
+(production byte-identical to HEAD^1), passed as the script's ref, so every
+child on either side records. `--plain` runs the gate's own tracing instead
+(hook prepended to PYTHONPATH, ref HEAD^1) for the side-by-side.
+
+Instrumented symbol: tests/mutation_table.py:REACH_HOOK / collect over each
+script's processes; tests/closures.json `closures` for the edges.
+Perturbation: `--plain` (the gate's own tracing) -> for tests/stress.py and
+tests/env_drift.py the executed-line count of every cell file falls (to the
+parent's own import-time lines), `recorded < started`; the hastub arm is the
+fixed instrument. `--drop FILE` zeroes one file's hits -> over_approx_pairs
+up by the number of scripts that executed it (identity = null).
+
+Run (repo root): PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/m5_trace_hastub.py --scripts tests/stress.py,tests/env_drift.py,tests/golden.py [--plain] [--drop FILE] [--out FILE]
+Writes only under $TMPDIR. Exact counts; seconds provisional.
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-m5 (Linux
+x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz), alone on the box.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import json
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time as _t
+_P0, _T0 = _t.process_time(), _t.thread_time()
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+RELS = [mt.PKG + c + ".py" for c in CELLS]
+
+
+def synthetic_ref(tree: Path, root: Path, text: str) -> str:
+    def g(*c, **k):
+        return subprocess.run(["git", *c], cwd=tree, capture_output=True,
+                              text=True, check=True, **k).stdout.strip()
+    blob = g("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", input=text)
+    env_i = {**os.environ, "GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(root / "idx")}
+    subprocess.run(["git", "read-tree", "HEAD^1"], cwd=tree, env=env_i, check=True)
+    subprocess.run(["git", "update-index", "--add", "--cacheinfo",
+                    f"100644,{blob},tests/hastub/sitecustomize.py"], cwd=tree,
+                   env=env_i, check=True)
+    t = subprocess.run(["git", "write-tree"], cwd=tree, env=env_i,
+                       capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
+    return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.name=d3s1", "-c", "user.email=d3s1@invalid",
+                           "commit-tree", t, "-p", g("rev-parse", "HEAD^1"), "-m",
+                           "d3s1 reach ref: HEAD^1 + hastub reach hook"], cwd=tree,
+                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
+
+
+def gate_spec(s: str, ref: str) -> tuple[list[str], dict]:
+    if s == "tests/golden.py":
+        return [], {"GOLDEN_MODE": "strict", "GOLDEN_REF": ref}
+    return mt.drive_spec(s, ref)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--scripts", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--plain", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--drop")
+    ap.add_argument("--out")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    clos = mt.load_closures()
+    exe = {r: mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / r) for r in RELS}
+    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-tracehs-"))
+    tree = root / "tree"
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet", str(tree),
+                    "HEAD"], cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True)
+    over_total, pairs_total = 0, 0
+    try:
+        ref = "HEAD^1"
+        hookdir = root / "_hook"
+        hookdir.mkdir()
+        (hookdir / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(mt.REACH_HOOK)
+        if not a.plain:
+            (tree / "tests" / "hastub" / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(mt.REACH_HOOK)
+            ref = synthetic_ref(tree, root, mt.REACH_HOOK)
+            print(f"# synthetic ref {ref}")
+        for s in a.scripts.split(","):
+            out = root / ("rec-" + s.replace("/", "_"))
+            out.mkdir()
+            args, extra = gate_spec(s, ref)
+            pp = "tests/hastub" if not a.plain else f"{hookdir}{os.pathsep}tests/hastub"
+            env = {**os.environ, **extra, "PYTHONPATH": pp, "HPO_REACH_OUT": str(out),
+                   "HPO_PLANDATA": str(root / "plan.json")}
+            t0 = time.monotonic()
+            p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, s, *args], cwd=tree, env=env,
+                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=14400)
+            wall = time.monotonic() - t0
+            reach = mt.collect(out)
+            reach["rc"] = p.returncode
+            row = {"script": s, "arm": "plain" if a.plain else "hastub",
+                   "rc": p.returncode, "wall_s": round(wall, 1), "provisional": True,
+                   "processes": reach["processes"], "foreign": reach["foreign"][:8],
+                   "untraced": reach["untraced"][:8],
+                   "reach_problems": mt.reach_problems(reach), "files": {},
+                   "stdout_tail": p.stdout[-600:], "stderr_tail": p.stderr[-600:]}
+            over = []
+            for r in RELS:
+                if r not in clos.get(s, ()):
+                    continue
+                pairs_total += 1
+                hits = set(reach["hits"].get(r, ())) & exe[r]
+                if r == a.drop:
+                    hits = set()
+                read = r in reach["reads"]
+                row["files"][r.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]] = {
+                    "executed": len(hits), "executable": len(exe[r]), "read": read}
+                if not hits and not read:
+                    over.append(r.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+            row["over_approx"] = over
+            over_total += len(over)
+            print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in ("stdout_tail", "stderr_tail")}), flush=True)
+            if a.out:
+                with open(a.out, "a") as f:
+                    f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
+            key = s.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].replace(".py", "")
+            print(f"RESULT {key}_cell_lines_executed={sum(v['executed'] for v in row['files'].values())}")
+            print(f"RESULT {key}_procs_started={reach['processes']['started']} recorded={reach['processes']['recorded']}")
+            print(f"RESULT {key}_over_approx_pairs={len(over)}")
+            print(f"RESULT {key}_wall_s={wall:.1f} s (provisional)")
+    finally:
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", str(tree)],
+                       cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+        shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "prune"], cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+    print(f"RESULT closure_pairs={pairs_total}")
+    print(f"RESULT over_approx_pairs={over_total}")
+    print(f"RESULT load1={os.getloadavg()[0]:.2f}")
+    print(f"RESULT thread_factor={(_t.process_time() - _P0) / max(_t.thread_time() - _T0, 1e-9):.2f}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
