@@ -0,0 +1,580 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 pre-screen: does the measured closure notice a one-line mutant?
+
+Metric (per mutant): KILLED by <driver> | SURVIVED <drivers run> -- a kill is
+`tests/mutation_table.py:killed` (red AND more failing checks than the
+unmutated, traced baseline of the same driver); a driver whose traced baseline
+never executed the mutated line (`mutation_table.reach_skip`, the gate's own
+rule) is skipped and named. Count key: the mutant's verdict over the drivers
+the GATE runs (`tests/closures.json` closure of its file, `--scripts` default
+set, minus the brief's stress/edge/backtest), plus `tests/env_drift.py --all
+HEAD^1` (HEAD^1 = 2c84a85c, whose custom_components/ is byte-identical to the
+baseline: `git diff --stat HEAD^1 HEAD -- custom_components` is empty).
+
+Instrumented symbols: the production line of each mutant (inventory of
+`tests/mutation_table.py:inventory`, site `anchor`), driven through
+`mutation_table.run_script` / `killed` / `traced_baseline`.
+Perturbation: `--null` drives the comment-only null control (must LIVE);
+any mutant listed with `--force-kill-check` (the identity edit) must survive
+and a known-pinned site (a `killed_by` ledger row) must be killed.
+
+Commands (repo root, PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub):
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py baseline --workers 3
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py run --workers 3 [--limit N] [--anchors FILE]
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py run --full --anchors FILE   # no early stop (kill matrix)
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py null
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py reach      # whole-universe reach table
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py report
+Expected: null control LIVES; verdict counts in `report` (exact counts are
+contention-immune; every seconds figure is provisional).
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: owner macOS arm64, shared box.
+State: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/state/ (resumable); worker trees under $TMPDIR.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import queue
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import functools  # noqa: E402
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+mt.load_closures = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)(mt.load_closures)
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+STATE = HERE / "state"
+RESULTS = STATE / "results"
+BASE_FILE = STATE / "baselines.json"
+REF = "HEAD^1"
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+RELS = [mt.PKG + c + ".py" for c in CELLS]
+PRESCREEN_SKIP = {"tests/stress.py", "tests/edge.py", "tests/backtest.py"}
+KIND_RANK = {"GUARD_OFF": 0, "RAISE_DEL": 1, "CONST": 2, "CMP_BOUND": 3,
+             "BOOLOP": 4, "CLAMP_DROP": 5, "RETURN_DEL": 6}
+WT_ROOT = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "d3s1-workers"
+LOCK = threading.Lock()
+
+
+def drivers() -> list[str]:
+    clos = mt.load_closures()
+    allow = [s for s in mt.DEFAULT_SCRIPTS.split(",") if s not in PRESCREEN_SKIP]
+    return [s for s in allow if any(r in clos.get(s, ()) for r in RELS)]
+
+
+def unpinned() -> list[dict]:
+    budgets = mt.load_budgets()
+    inv = mt.inventory(sorted(mt.PRODUCTION / (c + ".py") for c in CELLS))
+    return mt.unpinned_sites(budgets, inv)
+
+
+def pinned() -> list[dict]:
+    budgets = mt.load_budgets()
+    inv = mt.inventory(sorted(mt.PRODUCTION / (c + ".py") for c in CELLS))
+    loose = {id(s) for s in mt.unpinned_sites(budgets, inv)}
+    return [s for s in inv if id(s) not in loose]
+
+
+def key(m: dict) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha1((m["anchor"] + "|" + m["new"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def tree(i: int) -> Path:
+    d = WT_ROOT / f"w{i}"
+    if not (d / ".git").exists():
+        d.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet",
+                        str(d), "HEAD"], cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True,
+                       capture_output=True)
+    return d
+
+
+FRESH = os.environ.get("D3S1_FRESH_TREE", "0") == "1"
+
+
+def recycle(i: int) -> Path:
+    """Box D3R (disk rule): delete a worker's tree after each mutant and
+    re-add it, so no mutant leaves files behind for the next one."""
+    d = WT_ROOT / f"w{i}"
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", str(d)],
+                   cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "prune"], cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+    return tree(i)
+
+
+def spec(script):
+    return mt.drive_spec(script, REF)
+
+
+def to_json(run: mt.ScriptRun) -> dict:
+    return {"rc": run.rc, "failed": run.failed, "seconds": round(run.seconds, 1),
+            "timed_out": run.timed_out,
+            "checks": mt.failed_checks(run)[:5],
+            "stdout_tail": run.stdout[-1500:], "stderr_tail": run.stderr[-1500:]}
+
+
+def from_json(d: dict) -> mt.ScriptRun:
+    return mt.ScriptRun(d["rc"], d["failed"], d["seconds"],
+                        d.get("stdout_tail", ""), d.get("stderr_tail", ""),
+                        d.get("timed_out", False))
+
+
+def timeout_for(script, base) -> int:
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds().get(script, 60.0)
+    seen = base.get(script, {}).get("run", {}).get("seconds", rec)
+    return mt.driver_timeout(1200, max(rec, seen))
+
+
+def log(msg: str) -> None:
+    line = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()) + " " + msg
+    with LOCK:
+        print(line, flush=True)
+        with open(STATE / "prescreen.log", "a") as f:
+            f.write(line + "\n")
+
+
+def cmd_baseline(args) -> int:
+    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    base = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text()) if BASE_FILE.exists() else {}
+    todo = [s for s in drivers() if s not in base]
+    q: "queue.Queue[str]" = queue.Queue()
+    # longest first (recorded seconds)
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    for s in sorted(todo, key=lambda s: -rec.get(s, 60)):
+        q.put(s)
+
+    def work(i):
+        t = tree(i)
+        while True:
+            try:
+                s = q.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return
+            a, e = spec(s)
+            t0 = time.process_time()
+            run, reach = mt.traced_baseline(mt.run_script, s, t,
+                                            mt.driver_timeout(1200, 3 * rec.get(s, 60)),
+                                            a, e)
+            entry = {"run": to_json(run), "reach": reach,
+                     "reach_problems": mt.reach_problems(reach)}
+            with LOCK:
+                cur = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text()) if BASE_FILE.exists() else {}
+                cur[s] = entry
+                BASE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+            log(f"BASELINE {s} rc={run.rc} failed={run.failed} "
+                f"wall={run.seconds:.1f}s reach_ok={not entry['reach_problems']}")
+            del t0
+    ths = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(args.workers)]
+    for th in ths:
+        th.start()
+    for th in ths:
+        th.join()
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_retrace(args) -> int:
+    """Trace a driver whose baseline is red but COMPLETE (its closing
+    `N of M ... FAILED` line printed): mutation_table.traced_baseline drops
+    the reach of any red run; here the reach is kept, because the run reached
+    its summary, and the red count stays the kill threshold (`killed`)."""
+    s = args.script
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    t = tree(args.tree_offset or 4)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="reach-") as d:
+        out = Path(d)
+        env = mt.hook_env(out)
+        a, e = spec(s)
+        traced_env = {**e, **env,
+                      "PYTHONPATH": mt.traced_pythonpath(env, "tests/hastub")}
+        run = mt.run_script(s, t, mt.driver_timeout(1200, 3 * rec.get(s, 60)),
+                            a, traced_env)
+        reach = mt.collect(out)
+    complete = bool(mt._FAILED.search(run.stdout)) or run.rc == 0
+    reach["rc"] = 0 if complete else run.rc
+    entry = {"run": to_json(run), "reach": reach if complete else None,
+             "reach_problems": (mt.reach_problems(reach) if complete
+                                else ["incomplete"]),
+             "retraced_red_complete": complete}
+    with LOCK:
+        cur = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text())
+        cur[s] = entry
+        BASE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+    log(f"RETRACE {s} rc={run.rc} failed={run.failed} complete={complete} "
+        f"problems={entry['reach_problems']}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_trace_capture(args) -> int:
+    """env_drift.py's only production-executing step is its `--capture` child,
+    which it starts with PYTHONPATH reset to tests/hastub, dropping the reach
+    hook (so the gate's tracer records no lines for it). Trace that child
+    directly, `--all`, and store its reach as env_drift's `capture_reach`."""
+    t = tree(args.tree_offset or 7)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="reach-cap-") as d:
+        out = Path(d)
+        env = mt.hook_env(out)
+        cap = out / "capture.json"
+        e = {**os.environ, **env,
+             "PYTHONPATH": mt.traced_pythonpath(env, str(t / "tests" / "hastub"))}
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tests/env_drift.py", "--capture",
+                            str(t), str(cap), "--all"], cwd=t, env=e,
+                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=7200)
+        reach = mt.collect(out)
+    reach["rc"] = p.returncode
+    with LOCK:
+        cur = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text())
+        cur["tests/env_drift.py"]["capture_reach"] = reach
+        BASE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+    log(f"TRACE-CAPTURE rc={p.returncode} wall={time.monotonic() - t0:.1f}s "
+        f"problems={mt.reach_problems(reach)} procs={reach['processes']}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def load_base() -> dict:
+    return json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text())
+
+
+def order(base: dict, ds: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    return sorted(ds, key=lambda s: base[s]["run"]["seconds"])
+
+
+RELAX = os.environ.get("D3S1_RELAX", "1") == "1"
+# D3.M2's pre-screen net is "the FAST scripts of that closure ... plus
+# tests/env_drift.py --all": fast = a recorded solo cost (tests/closures.json
+# `recorded.seconds`) under FAST_S. The slow ones (optimality, harness_headers,
+# boost_drift_replay, features, entities) are deferred to the --full drive
+# (D3.M3's full net) and named in each verdict as `deferred_slow`.
+FAST_S = float(os.environ.get("D3S1_FAST_S", "120"))
+
+
+def fast(s: str) -> bool:
+    return s == "tests/env_drift.py" or mt.recorded_seconds().get(s, 1e9) < FAST_S
+
+
+def relaxed_skip(reach, m) -> bool:
+    """The gate's reach_skip, plus one relaxation, named in every verdict:
+    a run whose ONLY refusal is that it starts `git` (which executes no
+    Python line) and whose unrecorded Python processes number at most one is
+    read for its executed lines. A survivor relying on this skip is marked
+    `relaxed_skipped`, and the re-drive with D3S1_RELAX=0 removes it."""
+    if not RELAX or reach is None:
+        return False
+    if reach["untraced"] or reach.get("rc") not in (0, None):
+        return False
+    if any(not f.startswith("git ") for f in reach["foreign"]):
+        return False
+    p = reach["processes"]
+    if p["started"] - p["recorded"] > 1:
+        return False
+    rel = m["file"]
+    if rel in reach["reads"]:
+        return False
+    if rel not in mt._EXECUTABLE:
+        mt._EXECUTABLE[rel] = mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / rel)
+    if m["line"] not in mt._EXECUTABLE[rel]:
+        return False
+    return m["line"] not in set(reach["hits"].get(rel, ()))
+
+
+def drive(t: Path, m: dict, base: dict, full: bool, nostop: bool = False) -> dict:
+    path = t / m["file"]
+    original = path.read_text()
+    lines = original.splitlines(True)
+    assert lines[m["line"] - 1].rstrip("\n") == m["old"], (m, lines[m["line"] - 1])
+    lines[m["line"] - 1] = m["new"] + "\n"
+    ds = [s for s in order(base, list(base)) if m["file"] in
+          mt.load_closures().get(s, ())]
+    out = {"mutant": m, "runs": {}, "skipped": [], "killed_by": [],
+           "started": time.time()}
+    try:
+        path.write_text("".join(lines))
+        for s in ds:
+            if not full and not fast(s):
+                out.setdefault("deferred_slow", []).append(s)
+                continue
+            if mt.reach_skip(base[s]["reach"], m):
+                out["skipped"].append(s)
+                continue
+            if relaxed_skip(base[s].get("capture_reach") or base[s]["reach"], m):
+                out.setdefault("relaxed_skipped", []).append(s)
+                continue
+            a, e = spec(s)
+            run = mt.run_script(s, t, timeout_for(s, base), a, e)
+            k = mt.killed(s, run, from_json(base[s]["run"]))
+            j = to_json(run)
+            j["killed"] = k
+            out["runs"][s] = j
+            if k:
+                out["killed_by"].append(s)
+                if not (full or nostop):
+                    break
+    finally:
+        path.write_text(original)
+    out["wall"] = round(time.time() - out["started"], 1)
+    out["verdict"] = "KILLED" if out["killed_by"] else (
+        "TIMEOUT" if any(r["timed_out"] for r in out["runs"].values())
+        else "SURVIVED")
+    return out
+
+
+def cmd_run(args) -> int:
+    base = load_base()
+    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    pool = unpinned()
+    if args.anchors:
+        want = [ln.strip() for ln in Path(args.anchors).read_text().splitlines()
+                if ln.strip()]
+        byk = {}
+        for m in pool + pinned():
+            byk.setdefault(m["anchor"], m)
+            byk.setdefault(key(m), m)
+        pool = [byk[w] for w in want if w in byk]
+    elif args.mutants:
+        pool = json.loads(Path(args.mutants).read_text())
+    else:
+        pool = weighted(pool)
+    sub = args.sub or ("full" if args.full else "pre")
+    done = {p.stem for p in (RESULTS / sub).glob("*.json")} if (RESULTS / sub).exists() else set()
+    (RESULTS / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    pool = [m for m in pool if key(m) not in done]
+    if args.limit:
+        pool = pool[: args.limit]
+    stop = STATE / "STOP"
+    q: "queue.Queue[dict]" = queue.Queue()
+    for m in pool:
+        q.put(m)
+    log(f"RUN {sub} queued={len(pool)} workers={args.workers}")
+
+    def work(i):
+        t = tree(i + args.tree_offset)
+        while not stop.exists():
+            try:
+                m = q.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return
+            r = drive(t, m, base, args.full)
+            (RESULTS / sub / (key(m) + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(r))
+            if FRESH:
+                t = recycle(i + args.tree_offset)
+            log(f"{sub.upper()} {r['verdict']} {m['anchor']} L{m['line']} "
+                f"by={','.join(r['killed_by']) or '-'} ran={len(r['runs'])} "
+                f"skip={len(r['skipped'])} wall={r['wall']}s")
+    ths = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(args.workers)]
+    for th in ths:
+        th.start()
+    for th in ths:
+        th.join()
+    return 0
+
+
+def weighted(pool: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    """Consequence weighting (D3.M1): kind rank, round-robin over files."""
+    per: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    for m in sorted(pool, key=lambda m: (KIND_RANK.get(m["kind"], 9), m["line"])):
+        per.setdefault(m["file"], []).append(m)
+    out = []
+    while any(per.values()):
+        for f in sorted(per):
+            if per[f]:
+                out.append(per[f].pop(0))
+    return out
+
+
+def cmd_complete(args) -> int:
+    """D3.M3's full net for pre-screen survivors: re-drive each survivor of
+    results/<--from>/ (or the keys in --keys) through every driver the fast
+    drive deferred or skipped by the relaxed reach (no relaxation, no early
+    stop), and write the merged verdict to results/complete/."""
+    global RELAX
+    RELAX = False
+    base = load_base()
+    src = RESULTS / args.src
+    want = None
+    if args.keys:
+        want = [k.strip() for k in Path(args.keys).read_text().split() if k.strip()]
+    rs = []
+    for p in sorted(src.glob("*.json")):
+        r = json.loads(p.read_text())
+        if want is not None and p.stem not in want:
+            continue
+        if want is None and r["verdict"] != "SURVIVED":
+            continue
+        rs.append((p.stem, r))
+    if want:
+        rs.sort(key=lambda kr: want.index(kr[0]))
+    out_dir = RESULTS / "complete"
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    done = {p.stem for p in out_dir.glob("*.json")}
+    q: "queue.Queue" = queue.Queue()
+    for k, r in rs:
+        if k not in done:
+            q.put((k, r))
+    log(f"COMPLETE queued={q.qsize()} from={args.src}")
+
+    def work(i):
+        t = tree(i + args.tree_offset)
+        while not (STATE / "STOP").exists():
+            try:
+                k, r = q.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return
+            m = r["mutant"]
+            extra = (r.get("deferred_slow", []) + r.get("relaxed_skipped", []))
+            path = t / m["file"]
+            original = path.read_text()
+            lines = original.splitlines(True)
+            assert lines[m["line"] - 1].rstrip("\n") == m["old"]
+            lines[m["line"] - 1] = m["new"] + "\n"
+            t0 = time.time()
+            try:
+                path.write_text("".join(lines))
+                for s in order(base, extra):
+                    if mt.reach_skip(base[s]["reach"], m):
+                        r["skipped"].append(s)
+                        continue
+                    a, e = spec(s)
+                    run = mt.run_script(s, t, timeout_for(s, base), a, e)
+                    j = to_json(run)
+                    j["killed"] = mt.killed(s, run, from_json(base[s]["run"]))
+                    r["runs"][s] = j
+                    if j["killed"]:
+                        r["killed_by"].append(s)
+            finally:
+                path.write_text(original)
+            r["complete_wall"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
+            r["completed"] = True
+            r.pop("deferred_slow", None)
+            r.pop("relaxed_skipped", None)
+            r["verdict"] = "KILLED" if r["killed_by"] else (
+                "TIMEOUT" if any(x["timed_out"] for x in r["runs"].values())
+                else "SURVIVED")
+            (out_dir / (k + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(r))
+            log(f"COMPLETE {r['verdict']} {m['anchor']} L{m['line']} "
+                f"by={','.join(r['killed_by']) or '-'} ran={len(r['runs'])} "
+                f"wall={r['complete_wall']}s")
+    ths = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(args.workers)]
+    for th in ths:
+        th.start()
+    for th in ths:
+        th.join()
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_null(args) -> int:
+    base = load_base()
+    null = mt.null_for([{"file": r} for r in RELS])
+    t = tree(4)
+    r = drive(t, null, base, args.full, nostop=True)
+    (STATE / ("null-full.json" if args.full else "null.json")).write_text(json.dumps(r))
+    print(f"RESULT null_verdict={'LIVES' if not r['killed_by'] else 'KILLED:' + ','.join(r['killed_by'])}")
+    print(f"RESULT null_drivers_run={len(r['runs'])}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def classify(base: dict, s: str, m: dict) -> str:
+    """exec | noexec | reader | unknown for driver s on mutant m's line."""
+    reach = base[s].get("capture_reach") or base[s]["reach"]
+    rel, line = m["file"], m["line"]
+    if rel not in mt._EXECUTABLE:
+        mt._EXECUTABLE[rel] = mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / rel)
+    if line not in mt._EXECUTABLE[rel]:
+        return "unknown"
+    if mt.reach_skip(base[s]["reach"], m) or relaxed_skip(reach, m):
+        return "noexec"
+    if reach is None:
+        return "unknown"
+    if line in set(reach["hits"].get(rel, ())):
+        return "exec"
+    if rel in reach["reads"]:
+        return "reader"
+    return "unknown"
+
+
+def cmd_reach(args) -> int:
+    """Whole-universe reach (D3.M1 weighting): for each unpinned site, which
+    drivers of its closure execute its line in their unmutated run. Writes
+    state/reach.tsv; prints per-file counts of sites NO driver executes and no
+    driver's reach is unknown for (`dead_to_gate`): only a text reader
+    (structure/archscore/doc lints) can see such a mutant at all."""
+    from collections import Counter
+    base = load_base()
+    rows = []
+    for m in unpinned():
+        ds = [s for s in base if m["file"] in mt.load_closures().get(s, ())]
+        cls = {s: classify(base, s, m) for s in ds}
+        rows.append((m, cls))
+    dead, unk = Counter(), Counter()
+    with open(STATE / "reach.tsv", "w") as f:
+        for m, cls in rows:
+            ex = sorted(s for s, c in cls.items() if c == "exec")
+            un = sorted(s for s, c in cls.items() if c == "unknown")
+            f.write(f"{m['anchor']}\t{m['line']}\t{m['kind']}\t"
+                    f"exec={','.join(ex)}\tunknown={','.join(un)}\n")
+            fn = m["file"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+            if not ex and not un:
+                dead[fn] += 1
+            elif not ex:
+                unk[fn] += 1
+    for fn in sorted(set(dead) | set(unk)):
+        print(f"  {fn}: dead_to_gate={dead[fn]} only_unknown_reach={unk[fn]}")
+    print(f"RESULT unpinned_sites={len(rows)}")
+    print(f"RESULT dead_to_gate={sum(dead.values())}")
+    print(f"RESULT only_unknown_reach={sum(unk.values())}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_report(args) -> int:
+    from collections import Counter
+    for sub in ("pre", "full", "c2", "c3c6", "complete"):
+        d = RESULTS / sub
+        if not d.exists():
+            continue
+        rs = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in d.glob("*.json")]
+        c = Counter(r["verdict"] for r in rs)
+        print(f"RESULT {sub}_mutants={len(rs)}")
+        for v, n in sorted(c.items()):
+            print(f"RESULT {sub}_{v.lower()}={n}")
+        kb = Counter(r["killed_by"][0] for r in rs if r["killed_by"])
+        for s, n in kb.most_common():
+            print(f"  first-kill {s}: {n}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=("baseline", "run", "null", "reach", "report", "retrace", "trace-capture", "complete"))
+    ap.add_argument("--src", default="pre")
+    ap.add_argument("--keys")
+    ap.add_argument("--script")
+    ap.add_argument("--mutants", help="JSON list of mutant dicts to drive")
+    ap.add_argument("--sub", help="results subdirectory name")
+    ap.add_argument("--tree-offset", type=int, default=0)
+    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
+    ap.add_argument("--anchors")
+    ap.add_argument("--full", action="store_true")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    rc = {"baseline": cmd_baseline, "run": cmd_run, "null": cmd_null,
+          "reach": cmd_reach, "report": cmd_report, "retrace": cmd_retrace, "trace-capture": cmd_trace_capture, "complete": cmd_complete}[args.cmd](args)
+    ld = os.getloadavg()[0]
+    print(f"RESULT load1={ld:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return rc
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..dc5340f0d6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py
@@ -0,0 +1,658 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""D3-s1 pre-screen: does the measured closure notice a one-line mutant?
+
+Metric (per mutant): KILLED by <driver> | SURVIVED <drivers run> -- a kill is
+`tests/mutation_table.py:killed` (red AND more failing checks than the
+unmutated, traced baseline of the same driver); a driver whose traced baseline
+never executed the mutated line (`mutation_table.reach_skip`, the gate's own
+rule) is skipped and named. Count key: the mutant's verdict over the drivers
+the GATE runs (`tests/closures.json` closure of its file, `--scripts` default
+set, minus the brief's stress/edge/backtest), plus `tests/env_drift.py --all
+HEAD^1` (HEAD^1 = 2c84a85c, whose custom_components/ is byte-identical to the
+baseline: `git diff --stat HEAD^1 HEAD -- custom_components` is empty).
+
+Instrumented symbols: the production line of each mutant (inventory of
+`tests/mutation_table.py:inventory`, site `anchor`), driven through
+`mutation_table.run_script` / `killed` / `traced_baseline`.
+Perturbation: `--null` drives the comment-only null control (must LIVE);
+any mutant listed with `--force-kill-check` (the identity edit) must survive
+and a known-pinned site (a `killed_by` ledger row) must be killed.
+
+Commands (repo root, PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub):
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py baseline --workers 3
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py run --workers 3 [--limit N] [--anchors FILE]
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py run --full --anchors FILE   # no early stop (kill matrix)
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py null
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py reach      # whole-universe reach table
+  python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py report
+Expected: null control LIVES; verdict counts in `report` (exact counts are
+contention-immune; every seconds figure is provisional).
+Box D3-m5 (D3.M5(b), the kill-overlap matrix, no early stop over every
+closure script):
+  D3S1_RELAX=0 D3S1_FRESH_TREE=1 D3S1_EXTRA_DRIVERS=tests/edge.py,tests/backtest.py,tests/golden.py,tests/card.mjs,tests/card_drift.mjs \
+    python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/prescreen.py baseline --workers 4
+  D3S1_EXTRA_DRIVERS=tests/stress.py python3 .../prescreen.py baseline --workers 1   # alone
+  D3S1_RELAX=0 D3S1_FRESH_TREE=1 D3S1_EXTRA_DRIVERS=... D3S1_ONLY=<every driver but stress> \
+    python3 .../prescreen.py run --full --mutants dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/matrix_mutants.json --sub matrix --workers 4
+  D3S1_RELAX=0 D3S1_FRESH_TREE=1 D3S1_ONLY=tests/stress.py python3 .../prescreen.py run --full --mutants ... --sub matrix-stress --workers 1
+Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: owner macOS arm64, shared box;
+box D3R and box D3-m5 (Linux x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz), each alone.
+State: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/state/ (resumable); worker trees under $TMPDIR.
+"""
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+           "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import queue
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+import functools  # noqa: E402
+import mutation_table as mt  # noqa: E402
+mt.load_closures = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)(mt.load_closures)
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+STATE = HERE / "state"
+RESULTS = STATE / "results"
+BASE_FILE = STATE / "baselines.json"
+REF = "HEAD^1"
+CELLS = ["coordinator", "optimizer", "thermal_model", "sysid", "defrost",
+         "flow_lift", "process_worker", "batchmath", "price_model", "tariff",
+         "grid_fee", "dhw_planner"]
+RELS = [mt.PKG + c + ".py" for c in CELLS]
+PRESCREEN_SKIP = {"tests/stress.py", "tests/edge.py", "tests/backtest.py"}
+KIND_RANK = {"GUARD_OFF": 0, "RAISE_DEL": 1, "CONST": 2, "CMP_BOUND": 3,
+             "BOOLOP": 4, "CLAMP_DROP": 5, "RETURN_DEL": 6}
+WT_ROOT = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "d3s1-workers"
+LOCK = threading.Lock()
+
+
+# Box D3-m5 (D3.M5(b), the kill-overlap matrix over EVERY closure script):
+# D3S1_EXTRA_DRIVERS adds drivers the pre-screen leaves out -- edge.py,
+# backtest.py, stress.py (PRESCREEN_SKIP) and the three DRIVER_EXCLUSIONS:
+# golden.py (driven in run.sh's default strict mode, GOLDEN_MODE=strict
+# GOLDEN_REF=HEAD^1, which compares the committed fixtures, NOT the
+# env_drift step), card.mjs and card_drift.mjs (run under node after their
+# producer tests/plan_view.py, closure.py PRODUCERS, on a private
+# HPO_PLANDATA). A node driver's reach is its producer's traced reach: the
+# node process executes no Python, and the payload is the only way a Python
+# line reaches it. D3S1_ONLY restricts a drive to the listed drivers.
+NODE = ("tests/card.mjs", "tests/card_drift.mjs")
+EXTRA = [x for x in os.environ.get("D3S1_EXTRA_DRIVERS", "").split(",") if x]
+ONLY = {x for x in os.environ.get("D3S1_ONLY", "").split(",") if x}
+
+
+def drivers() -> list[str]:
+    clos = mt.load_closures()
+    allow = [s for s in mt.DEFAULT_SCRIPTS.split(",") if s not in PRESCREEN_SKIP]
+    allow += [s for s in EXTRA if s not in allow]
+    return [s for s in allow if any(r in clos.get(s, ()) for r in RELS)]
+
+
+def run_any(s: str, t: Path, timeout: int, a=None, e=None) -> "mt.ScriptRun":
+    """mt.run_script for a Python driver; producer + node for a card driver."""
+    if s not in NODE:
+        return mt.run_script(s, t, timeout, a, e)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    pd = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="d3s1-plan-"))
+    env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": "tests/hastub",
+           "HPO_PLANDATA": str(pd / "plan.json")}
+    env.pop("HPO_REACH_OUT", None)
+    env.pop("HPO_REACH_HOOK", None)
+    try:
+        prod = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tests/plan_view.py"], cwd=t,
+                              env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
+                              timeout=timeout)
+        args = [REF] if s == "tests/card_drift.mjs" else []
+        try:
+            p = subprocess.run(["node", s, *args], cwd=t, env=env,
+                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            return mt.ScriptRun(mt.TIMEOUT_RC, 0, time.monotonic() - started,
+                                "", f"{s}: timed out after {timeout}s", True)
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(pd, ignore_errors=True)
+    out = (f"[producer tests/plan_view.py rc={prod.returncode}]\n"
+           + prod.stdout[-2000:] + "\n" + p.stdout)
+    run = mt.ScriptRun(p.returncode, 0, time.monotonic() - started, out,
+                       p.stderr)
+    n = mt.failing_count(run)
+    if p.returncode != 0 and n == 0:
+        # card_drift.mjs prints `card_drift: N problem(s).`; any other red
+        # node exit counts one failing check (it named none we can read).
+        import re as _re
+        m = _re.search(r"card_drift: (\d+) problem", p.stdout)
+        n = int(m.group(1)) if m else 1
+    return run._replace(failed=n)
+
+
+def killed_any(s: str, run, base_run) -> bool:
+    if s not in NODE:
+        return mt.killed(s, run, base_run)
+    return run.rc != 0 and run.failed > base_run.failed
+
+
+def unpinned() -> list[dict]:
+    budgets = mt.load_budgets()
+    inv = mt.inventory(sorted(mt.PRODUCTION / (c + ".py") for c in CELLS))
+    return mt.unpinned_sites(budgets, inv)
+
+
+def pinned() -> list[dict]:
+    budgets = mt.load_budgets()
+    inv = mt.inventory(sorted(mt.PRODUCTION / (c + ".py") for c in CELLS))
+    loose = {id(s) for s in mt.unpinned_sites(budgets, inv)}
+    return [s for s in inv if id(s) not in loose]
+
+
+def key(m: dict) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha1((m["anchor"] + "|" + m["new"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def tree(i: int) -> Path:
+    d = WT_ROOT / f"w{i}"
+    if not (d / ".git").exists():
+        d.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--quiet",
+                        str(d), "HEAD"], cwd=mt.ROOT, check=True,
+                       capture_output=True)
+    return d
+
+
+FRESH = os.environ.get("D3S1_FRESH_TREE", "0") == "1"
+
+
+def recycle(i: int) -> Path:
+    """Box D3R (disk rule): delete a worker's tree after each mutant and
+    re-add it, so no mutant leaves files behind for the next one."""
+    d = WT_ROOT / f"w{i}"
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", str(d)],
+                   cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
+    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "prune"], cwd=mt.ROOT, capture_output=True)
+    return tree(i)
+
+
+def spec(script):
+    if script == "tests/golden.py":
+        return [], {"GOLDEN_MODE": "strict", "GOLDEN_REF": REF}
+    return mt.drive_spec(script, REF)
+
+
+def to_json(run: mt.ScriptRun) -> dict:
+    return {"rc": run.rc, "failed": run.failed, "seconds": round(run.seconds, 1),
+            "timed_out": run.timed_out,
+            "checks": mt.failed_checks(run)[:5],
+            "stdout_tail": run.stdout[-1500:], "stderr_tail": run.stderr[-1500:]}
+
+
+def from_json(d: dict) -> mt.ScriptRun:
+    return mt.ScriptRun(d["rc"], d["failed"], d["seconds"],
+                        d.get("stdout_tail", ""), d.get("stderr_tail", ""),
+                        d.get("timed_out", False))
+
+
+def timeout_for(script, base) -> int:
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds().get(script, 60.0)
+    seen = base.get(script, {}).get("run", {}).get("seconds", rec)
+    return mt.driver_timeout(1200, max(rec, seen))
+
+
+def log(msg: str) -> None:
+    line = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()) + " " + msg
+    with LOCK:
+        print(line, flush=True)
+        with open(STATE / "prescreen.log", "a") as f:
+            f.write(line + "\n")
+
+
+def cmd_baseline(args) -> int:
+    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    base = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text()) if BASE_FILE.exists() else {}
+    todo = [s for s in drivers() if s not in base]
+    q: "queue.Queue[str]" = queue.Queue()
+    # longest first (recorded seconds)
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    for s in sorted(todo, key=lambda s: -rec.get(s, 60)):
+        q.put(s)
+
+    def work(i):
+        t = tree(i)
+        while True:
+            try:
+                s = q.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return
+            a, e = spec(s)
+            t0 = time.process_time()
+            if s in NODE:
+                run = run_any(s, t, mt.driver_timeout(1200, 3 * rec.get(s, 60)))
+                pv = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text()).get("tests/plan_view.py", {})
+                reach = pv.get("reach") if run.rc == 0 else None
+                entry = {"run": to_json(run), "reach": reach,
+                         "reach_from_producer": "tests/plan_view.py",
+                         "reach_problems": mt.reach_problems(reach)}
+            else:
+                run, reach = mt.traced_baseline(mt.run_script, s, t,
+                                                mt.driver_timeout(1200, 3 * rec.get(s, 60)),
+                                                a, e)
+                entry = {"run": to_json(run), "reach": reach,
+                         "reach_problems": mt.reach_problems(reach)}
+            with LOCK:
+                cur = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text()) if BASE_FILE.exists() else {}
+                cur[s] = entry
+                BASE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+            log(f"BASELINE {s} rc={run.rc} failed={run.failed} "
+                f"wall={run.seconds:.1f}s reach_ok={not entry['reach_problems']}")
+            del t0
+    ths = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(args.workers)]
+    for th in ths:
+        th.start()
+    for th in ths:
+        th.join()
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_retrace(args) -> int:
+    """Trace a driver whose baseline is red but COMPLETE (its closing
+    `N of M ... FAILED` line printed): mutation_table.traced_baseline drops
+    the reach of any red run; here the reach is kept, because the run reached
+    its summary, and the red count stays the kill threshold (`killed`)."""
+    s = args.script
+    rec = mt.recorded_seconds()
+    t = tree(args.tree_offset or 4)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="reach-") as d:
+        out = Path(d)
+        env = mt.hook_env(out)
+        a, e = spec(s)
+        traced_env = {**e, **env,
+                      "PYTHONPATH": mt.traced_pythonpath(env, "tests/hastub")}
+        run = mt.run_script(s, t, mt.driver_timeout(1200, 3 * rec.get(s, 60)),
+                            a, traced_env)
+        reach = mt.collect(out)
+    complete = bool(mt._FAILED.search(run.stdout)) or run.rc == 0
+    reach["rc"] = 0 if complete else run.rc
+    entry = {"run": to_json(run), "reach": reach if complete else None,
+             "reach_problems": (mt.reach_problems(reach) if complete
+                                else ["incomplete"]),
+             "retraced_red_complete": complete}
+    with LOCK:
+        cur = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text())
+        cur[s] = entry
+        BASE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+    log(f"RETRACE {s} rc={run.rc} failed={run.failed} complete={complete} "
+        f"problems={entry['reach_problems']}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_trace_capture(args) -> int:
+    """env_drift.py's only production-executing step is its `--capture` child,
+    which it starts with PYTHONPATH reset to tests/hastub, dropping the reach
+    hook (so the gate's tracer records no lines for it). Trace that child
+    directly, `--all`, and store its reach as env_drift's `capture_reach`."""
+    t = tree(args.tree_offset or 7)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="reach-cap-") as d:
+        out = Path(d)
+        env = mt.hook_env(out)
+        cap = out / "capture.json"
+        e = {**os.environ, **env,
+             "PYTHONPATH": mt.traced_pythonpath(env, str(t / "tests" / "hastub"))}
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tests/env_drift.py", "--capture",
+                            str(t), str(cap), "--all"], cwd=t, env=e,
+                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=7200)
+        reach = mt.collect(out)
+    reach["rc"] = p.returncode
+    with LOCK:
+        cur = json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text())
+        cur["tests/env_drift.py"]["capture_reach"] = reach
+        BASE_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(cur))
+    log(f"TRACE-CAPTURE rc={p.returncode} wall={time.monotonic() - t0:.1f}s "
+        f"problems={mt.reach_problems(reach)} procs={reach['processes']}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def load_base() -> dict:
+    return json.loads(BASE_FILE.read_text())
+
+
+def order(base: dict, ds: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    return sorted(ds, key=lambda s: base[s]["run"]["seconds"])
+
+
+RELAX = os.environ.get("D3S1_RELAX", "1") == "1"
+# D3.M2's pre-screen net is "the FAST scripts of that closure ... plus
+# tests/env_drift.py --all": fast = a recorded solo cost (tests/closures.json
+# `recorded.seconds`) under FAST_S. The slow ones (optimality, harness_headers,
+# boost_drift_replay, features, entities) are deferred to the --full drive
+# (D3.M3's full net) and named in each verdict as `deferred_slow`.
+FAST_S = float(os.environ.get("D3S1_FAST_S", "120"))
+
+
+def fast(s: str) -> bool:
+    return s == "tests/env_drift.py" or mt.recorded_seconds().get(s, 1e9) < FAST_S
+
+
+def relaxed_skip(reach, m) -> bool:
+    """The gate's reach_skip, plus one relaxation, named in every verdict:
+    a run whose ONLY refusal is that it starts `git` (which executes no
+    Python line) and whose unrecorded Python processes number at most one is
+    read for its executed lines. A survivor relying on this skip is marked
+    `relaxed_skipped`, and the re-drive with D3S1_RELAX=0 removes it."""
+    if not RELAX or reach is None:
+        return False
+    if reach["untraced"] or reach.get("rc") not in (0, None):
+        return False
+    if any(not f.startswith("git ") for f in reach["foreign"]):
+        return False
+    p = reach["processes"]
+    if p["started"] - p["recorded"] > 1:
+        return False
+    rel = m["file"]
+    if rel in reach["reads"]:
+        return False
+    if rel not in mt._EXECUTABLE:
+        mt._EXECUTABLE[rel] = mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / rel)
+    if m["line"] not in mt._EXECUTABLE[rel]:
+        return False
+    return m["line"] not in set(reach["hits"].get(rel, ()))
+
+
+def drive(t: Path, m: dict, base: dict, full: bool, nostop: bool = False) -> dict:
+    path = t / m["file"]
+    original = path.read_text()
+    lines = original.splitlines(True)
+    assert lines[m["line"] - 1].rstrip("\n") == m["old"], (m, lines[m["line"] - 1])
+    lines[m["line"] - 1] = m["new"] + "\n"
+    ds = [s for s in order(base, list(base)) if m["file"] in
+          mt.load_closures().get(s, ()) and (not ONLY or s in ONLY)]
+    out = {"mutant": m, "runs": {}, "skipped": [], "killed_by": [],
+           "started": time.time()}
+    try:
+        path.write_text("".join(lines))
+        for s in ds:
+            if not full and not fast(s):
+                out.setdefault("deferred_slow", []).append(s)
+                continue
+            if mt.reach_skip(base[s]["reach"], m):
+                out["skipped"].append(s)
+                continue
+            if relaxed_skip(base[s].get("capture_reach") or base[s]["reach"], m):
+                out.setdefault("relaxed_skipped", []).append(s)
+                continue
+            a, e = spec(s)
+            run = run_any(s, t, timeout_for(s, base), a, e)
+            k = killed_any(s, run, from_json(base[s]["run"]))
+            j = to_json(run)
+            j["killed"] = k
+            out["runs"][s] = j
+            if k:
+                out["killed_by"].append(s)
+                if not (full or nostop):
+                    break
+    finally:
+        path.write_text(original)
+    out["wall"] = round(time.time() - out["started"], 1)
+    out["verdict"] = "KILLED" if out["killed_by"] else (
+        "TIMEOUT" if any(r["timed_out"] for r in out["runs"].values())
+        else "SURVIVED")
+    return out
+
+
+def cmd_run(args) -> int:
+    base = load_base()
+    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    pool = unpinned()
+    if args.anchors:
+        want = [ln.strip() for ln in Path(args.anchors).read_text().splitlines()
+                if ln.strip()]
+        byk = {}
+        for m in pool + pinned():
+            byk.setdefault(m["anchor"], m)
+            byk.setdefault(key(m), m)
+        pool = [byk[w] for w in want if w in byk]
+    elif args.mutants:
+        pool = json.loads(Path(args.mutants).read_text())
+    else:
+        pool = weighted(pool)
+    sub = args.sub or ("full" if args.full else "pre")
+    done = {p.stem for p in (RESULTS / sub).glob("*.json")} if (RESULTS / sub).exists() else set()
+    (RESULTS / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    pool = [m for m in pool if key(m) not in done]
+    if args.limit:
+        pool = pool[: args.limit]
+    stop = STATE / "STOP"
+    q: "queue.Queue[dict]" = queue.Queue()
+    for m in pool:
+        q.put(m)
+    log(f"RUN {sub} queued={len(pool)} workers={args.workers}")
+
+    def work(i):
+        t = tree(i + args.tree_offset)
+        while not stop.exists():
+            try:
+                m = q.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return
+            r = drive(t, m, base, args.full)
+            (RESULTS / sub / (key(m) + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(r))
+            if FRESH:
+                t = recycle(i + args.tree_offset)
+            log(f"{sub.upper()} {r['verdict']} {m['anchor']} L{m['line']} "
+                f"by={','.join(r['killed_by']) or '-'} ran={len(r['runs'])} "
+                f"skip={len(r['skipped'])} wall={r['wall']}s")
+    ths = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(args.workers)]
+    for th in ths:
+        th.start()
+    for th in ths:
+        th.join()
+    return 0
+
+
+def weighted(pool: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
+    """Consequence weighting (D3.M1): kind rank, round-robin over files."""
+    per: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    for m in sorted(pool, key=lambda m: (KIND_RANK.get(m["kind"], 9), m["line"])):
+        per.setdefault(m["file"], []).append(m)
+    out = []
+    while any(per.values()):
+        for f in sorted(per):
+            if per[f]:
+                out.append(per[f].pop(0))
+    return out
+
+
+def cmd_complete(args) -> int:
+    """D3.M3's full net for pre-screen survivors: re-drive each survivor of
+    results/<--from>/ (or the keys in --keys) through every driver the fast
+    drive deferred or skipped by the relaxed reach (no relaxation, no early
+    stop), and write the merged verdict to results/complete/."""
+    global RELAX
+    RELAX = False
+    base = load_base()
+    src = RESULTS / args.src
+    want = None
+    if args.keys:
+        want = [k.strip() for k in Path(args.keys).read_text().split() if k.strip()]
+    rs = []
+    for p in sorted(src.glob("*.json")):
+        r = json.loads(p.read_text())
+        if want is not None and p.stem not in want:
+            continue
+        if want is None and r["verdict"] != "SURVIVED":
+            continue
+        rs.append((p.stem, r))
+    if want:
+        rs.sort(key=lambda kr: want.index(kr[0]))
+    out_dir = RESULTS / "complete"
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    done = {p.stem for p in out_dir.glob("*.json")}
+    q: "queue.Queue" = queue.Queue()
+    for k, r in rs:
+        if k not in done:
+            q.put((k, r))
+    log(f"COMPLETE queued={q.qsize()} from={args.src}")
+
+    def work(i):
+        t = tree(i + args.tree_offset)
+        while not (STATE / "STOP").exists():
+            try:
+                k, r = q.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return
+            m = r["mutant"]
+            extra = (r.get("deferred_slow", []) + r.get("relaxed_skipped", []))
+            path = t / m["file"]
+            original = path.read_text()
+            lines = original.splitlines(True)
+            assert lines[m["line"] - 1].rstrip("\n") == m["old"]
+            lines[m["line"] - 1] = m["new"] + "\n"
+            t0 = time.time()
+            try:
+                path.write_text("".join(lines))
+                for s in order(base, extra):
+                    if mt.reach_skip(base[s]["reach"], m):
+                        r["skipped"].append(s)
+                        continue
+                    a, e = spec(s)
+                    run = mt.run_script(s, t, timeout_for(s, base), a, e)
+                    j = to_json(run)
+                    j["killed"] = mt.killed(s, run, from_json(base[s]["run"]))
+                    r["runs"][s] = j
+                    if j["killed"]:
+                        r["killed_by"].append(s)
+            finally:
+                path.write_text(original)
+            r["complete_wall"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
+            r["completed"] = True
+            r.pop("deferred_slow", None)
+            r.pop("relaxed_skipped", None)
+            r["verdict"] = "KILLED" if r["killed_by"] else (
+                "TIMEOUT" if any(x["timed_out"] for x in r["runs"].values())
+                else "SURVIVED")
+            (out_dir / (k + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(r))
+            log(f"COMPLETE {r['verdict']} {m['anchor']} L{m['line']} "
+                f"by={','.join(r['killed_by']) or '-'} ran={len(r['runs'])} "
+                f"wall={r['complete_wall']}s")
+    ths = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(args.workers)]
+    for th in ths:
+        th.start()
+    for th in ths:
+        th.join()
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_null(args) -> int:
+    base = load_base()
+    null = mt.null_for([{"file": r} for r in RELS])
+    t = tree(4)
+    r = drive(t, null, base, args.full, nostop=True)
+    (STATE / ("null-full.json" if args.full else "null.json")).write_text(json.dumps(r))
+    print(f"RESULT null_verdict={'LIVES' if not r['killed_by'] else 'KILLED:' + ','.join(r['killed_by'])}")
+    print(f"RESULT null_drivers_run={len(r['runs'])}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def classify(base: dict, s: str, m: dict) -> str:
+    """exec | noexec | reader | unknown for driver s on mutant m's line."""
+    reach = base[s].get("capture_reach") or base[s]["reach"]
+    rel, line = m["file"], m["line"]
+    if rel not in mt._EXECUTABLE:
+        mt._EXECUTABLE[rel] = mt.executable_lines(mt.ROOT / rel)
+    if line not in mt._EXECUTABLE[rel]:
+        return "unknown"
+    if mt.reach_skip(base[s]["reach"], m) or relaxed_skip(reach, m):
+        return "noexec"
+    if reach is None:
+        return "unknown"
+    if line in set(reach["hits"].get(rel, ())):
+        return "exec"
+    if rel in reach["reads"]:
+        return "reader"
+    return "unknown"
+
+
+def cmd_reach(args) -> int:
+    """Whole-universe reach (D3.M1 weighting): for each unpinned site, which
+    drivers of its closure execute its line in their unmutated run. Writes
+    state/reach.tsv; prints per-file counts of sites NO driver executes and no
+    driver's reach is unknown for (`dead_to_gate`): only a text reader
+    (structure/archscore/doc lints) can see such a mutant at all."""
+    from collections import Counter
+    base = load_base()
+    rows = []
+    for m in unpinned():
+        ds = [s for s in base if m["file"] in mt.load_closures().get(s, ())]
+        cls = {s: classify(base, s, m) for s in ds}
+        rows.append((m, cls))
+    dead, unk = Counter(), Counter()
+    with open(STATE / "reach.tsv", "w") as f:
+        for m, cls in rows:
+            ex = sorted(s for s, c in cls.items() if c == "exec")
+            un = sorted(s for s, c in cls.items() if c == "unknown")
+            f.write(f"{m['anchor']}\t{m['line']}\t{m['kind']}\t"
+                    f"exec={','.join(ex)}\tunknown={','.join(un)}\n")
+            fn = m["file"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+            if not ex and not un:
+                dead[fn] += 1
+            elif not ex:
+                unk[fn] += 1
+    for fn in sorted(set(dead) | set(unk)):
+        print(f"  {fn}: dead_to_gate={dead[fn]} only_unknown_reach={unk[fn]}")
+    print(f"RESULT unpinned_sites={len(rows)}")
+    print(f"RESULT dead_to_gate={sum(dead.values())}")
+    print(f"RESULT only_unknown_reach={sum(unk.values())}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_report(args) -> int:
+    from collections import Counter
+    for sub in ("pre", "full", "c2", "c3c6", "complete"):
+        d = RESULTS / sub
+        if not d.exists():
+            continue
+        rs = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in d.glob("*.json")]
+        c = Counter(r["verdict"] for r in rs)
+        print(f"RESULT {sub}_mutants={len(rs)}")
+        for v, n in sorted(c.items()):
+            print(f"RESULT {sub}_{v.lower()}={n}")
+        kb = Counter(r["killed_by"][0] for r in rs if r["killed_by"])
+        for s, n in kb.most_common():
+            print(f"  first-kill {s}: {n}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=("baseline", "run", "null", "reach", "report", "retrace", "trace-capture", "complete"))
+    ap.add_argument("--src", default="pre")
+    ap.add_argument("--keys")
+    ap.add_argument("--script")
+    ap.add_argument("--mutants", help="JSON list of mutant dicts to drive")
+    ap.add_argument("--sub", help="results subdirectory name")
+    ap.add_argument("--tree-offset", type=int, default=0)
+    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
+    ap.add_argument("--anchors")
+    ap.add_argument("--full", action="store_true")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    rc = {"baseline": cmd_baseline, "run": cmd_run, "null": cmd_null,
+          "reach": cmd_reach, "report": cmd_report, "retrace": cmd_retrace, "trace-capture": cmd_trace_capture, "complete": cmd_complete}[args.cmd](args)
+    ld = os.getloadavg()[0]
+    print(f"RESULT load1={ld:.2f}")
+    print("RESULT thread_factor=1.00")
+    return rc
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Metric: number of holiday hot-water windows ThermalParameters.from_config stores (dhw_holiday_windows) for a
+#   config whose holiday-windows option is unset (absent / "" / None); None means "fall back to ordinary windows".
+# Command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_050fdc4a.py
+# EXPECTED RESULT holiday_unset_baseline_{absent,empty,none}=None  (no holiday override)
+# EXPECTED RESULT holiday_unset_mutant_{absent,empty,none}=[]  (an empty list is an override: no hot water on holidays)
+# EXPECTED RESULT unset_forms_moved=3 count
+# EXPECTED RESULT null_delta=0 count  (a configured spec "08:00-10:00": guard inert, identical windows)
+# EXPECTED RESULT reach_unset_calls=3 count  (production from_config calls with the option unset)
+# Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-rem (4 vCPU Xeon @ 2.10GHz).
+# Instrumented symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.thermal_model:_holiday_dhw_windows, line 169
+#   `if not spec:`, called from ThermalParameters.from_config (thermal_model.py:1157); consumed at

+# Perturbation: key 050fdc4a20eba212, `    if not spec:` -> `    if False:` (GUARD_OFF), in memory: the function is

+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import inspect, sys, textwrap
+from pathlib import Path

+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path

+        here = here.parent

+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer import const, thermal_model as tm  # noqa: E402
+
+src = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(tm._holiday_dhw_windows))
+assert src.count("    if not spec:") == 1, "anchor moved"
+ns = dict(tm.__dict__)
+exec(compile(src.replace("    if not spec:", "    if False:", 1), tm.__file__, "exec"), ns)
+mut = ns["_holiday_dhw_windows"]
+
+KEY = const.CONF_HOLIDAY_DHW_WINDOWS
+forms = {"absent": {}, "empty": {KEY: ""}, "none": {KEY: None}}
+
+
+def holiday(cfg, fn=None):
+    if fn is None:
+        return tm.ThermalParameters.from_config(cfg).dhw_holiday_windows
+    with mock.patch.object(tm, "_holiday_dhw_windows", fn):
+        return tm.ThermalParameters.from_config(cfg).dhw_holiday_windows

@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Metric: total DHW electrical energy (kWh, plan.sum()*dt) that DhwPlanner._plan_dhw_min_cost buys on a fixed 12-step
+#   horizon whose availability floor (60 C) can only be met by buying in steps priced far above the shortfall slack.
+# Command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_0911281e.py
+# EXPECTED RESULT dhw_kwh_baseline=2.5056 kWh  (spread prices: steps 0-10 at 100000, step 11 at 0; floor 60 C)
+# EXPECTED RESULT dhw_kwh_mutant=1.9948 kWh    (penalty 1000*(min|p|+1)=1000 < 100000/cop: slack beats buying)
+# EXPECTED RESULT null_delta_kwh=0.0 kWh           (flat price 1.0: min=max, the edit cannot matter)
+# EXPECTED RESULT realistic_delta_kwh=0.000000 kWh (price spread 0.1..5.0 per kWh, an ordinary day)
+# EXPECTED RESULT min_price_for_separation=8000 per-kWh (smallest swept max price at which mutant != baseline)
+# Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-rem (4 vCPU Xeon @ 2.10GHz).
+# Instrumented symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.dhw_planner:DhwPlanner._plan_dhw_min_cost (line 1559
+#   `            shortfall_price = 1000.0 * (float(np.max(np.abs(prices))) + 1.0)`), reached from DhwPlanner.optimize
+#   (dhw_planner.py:1235) as the stage-1 seed.
+# Perturbation: np.max -> np.min on that line (GUARD-free value mutant 0911281eca895664), in memory: the method is
+#   re-compiled from its own source and attached with mock.patch.object for the mutant arm only.
+#   Direction: DHW kWh down (slack is cheaper than buying), only once price/COP > 1000*(min|p|+1).
+# Reach: separation needs price/COP above 1000*(min|p|+1), i.e. a per-kWh price of about 8000 with a free step
+#   in the horizon; an ordinary 0.1..5.0 per-kWh day does not move (realistic_delta). Reachable only in a
+#   unit that prices a kWh in the thousands (e.g. a sub-unit price scale); see UNCERTAINTIES.
+# Null control: a flat price vector, where np.max == np.min.
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import inspect, sys, textwrap
+from dataclasses import replace
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest import mock
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer import dhw_planner  # noqa: E402
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.dhw_planner import DhwPlanner, _DhwPlanContext  # noqa: E402
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.optimizer import HeatPumpOptimizer, OptimizationConfig  # noqa: E402
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.thermal_model import ThermalModel, ThermalParameters  # noqa: E402
+
+OLD = "shortfall_price = 1000.0 * (float(np.max(np.abs(prices))) + 1.0)"
+NEW = "shortfall_price = 1000.0 * (float(np.min(np.abs(prices))) + 1.0)"
+
+
+def mutant_fn():
+    src = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(DhwPlanner._plan_dhw_min_cost))
+    assert src.count(OLD) == 1, "anchor line moved"
+    ns = dict(dhw_planner.__dict__)
+    exec(compile(src.replace(OLD, NEW, 1), dhw_planner.__file__, "exec"), ns)
+    return ns["_plan_dhw_min_cost"]
+
+
+params = ThermalParameters(dhw_enabled=True, dhw_tank_volume=200.0, dhw_cooling_rate=0.3)
+opt = HeatPumpOptimizer(ThermalModel(params), OptimizationConfig(
+    horizon_hours=24, time_step_minutes=15, target_temp=21.0, min_temp=17.0, max_temp=23.0))
+planner = DhwPlanner(opt.model, opt.config, opt._pv_surplus, opt._price_known)
+N = 12
+MUT = mutant_fn()
+
+
+def kwh(prices, method=None):
+    ctx = _DhwPlanContext(
+        prices=prices, import_prices=prices, outdoor_temps=np.full(N, -5.0), humidity=None, n_steps=N, dt=1.0,
+        store=replace(params.dhw_store, capacity_kwh_per_c=0.232), p_dhw_max=3.0, min_run_power=0.1,
+        max_lead_steps=24, tank_exo_kw=None)
+    fn = method or DhwPlanner._plan_dhw_min_cost
+    plan = fn(planner, ctx, 45.0, np.full(N, 60.0), np.zeros(N), np.full(N, 60.0))
+    return float("nan") if plan is None else float(plan.sum())
+
+
+spread = np.array([100000.0] * 11 + [0.0])
+flat = np.full(N, 1.0)
+real = np.linspace(0.1, 5.0, N)
+b, m = kwh(spread), kwh(spread, MUT)
+print(f"RESULT dhw_kwh_baseline={b:.4f} kWh")
+print(f"RESULT dhw_kwh_mutant={m:.4f} kWh")
+print(f"RESULT delta_kwh={m - b:.4f} kWh")
+print(f"RESULT null_delta_kwh={abs(kwh(flat, MUT) - kwh(flat)):.6f} kWh")
+print(f"RESULT realistic_delta_kwh={abs(kwh(real, MUT) - kwh(real)):.6f} kWh")
+sep = None
+for hi in (5, 20, 50, 100, 300, 600, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, 10000, 100000):
+    p = np.array([float(hi)] * 11 + [0.0])
+    if abs(kwh(p, MUT) - kwh(p)) > 1e-6:
+        sep = hi
+        break
+print(f"RESULT min_price_for_separation={sep} per-kWh")

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Metric: learned FlowCurveBias.bias_k (K) after 5 warm-up residuals of +2 K then 5 residuals of +6 K (curve 25 C).
+# Command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_0c3e91a6.py
+# EXPECTED RESULT bias_baseline=3.638040 K
+# EXPECTED RESULT bias_mutant=4.689280 K
+# EXPECTED RESULT delta=1.051240 K
+# EXPECTED RESULT null_delta=0.0 K  (warm-up only: alpha unread while samples < FLOW_BIAS_MIN_SAMPLES)
+# Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-rem (4 vCPU Xeon @ 2.10GHz).
+# Instrumented symbol: flow_lift:FlowCurveBias.observe, line 194-195 reading FLOW_BIAS_ALPHA (constant at line 47).
+#   FLOW_BIAS_ALPHA is read as a module global at call time; no other module imports it (grep), so one
+#   mock.patch.object(flow_lift, "FLOW_BIAS_ALPHA", 0.2) covers every production binding.
+# Perturbation: 0.1 -> 0.2 applied in memory; bias moves up (more weight on the +6 K residuals).
+# Null control: 5-sample warm-up only, plain-mean branch, alpha unused.
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import inspect, sys, textwrap
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest import mock
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer import flow_lift as fl  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def mutant_observe(old, new):
+    src = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(fl.FlowCurveBias.observe))
+    old = textwrap.dedent(old + "\n    pass").splitlines()[0]
+    new = textwrap.dedent(new + "\n    pass").splitlines()[0]
+    assert src.count(old) == 1, "anchor line moved"
+    ns = dict(fl.__dict__)
+    exec(compile(src.replace(old, new, 1), fl.__file__, "exec"), ns)
+    return ns["observe"]
+
+
+def run(seq, mutant=None):
+    b = fl.FlowCurveBias()
+    ctx = mock.patch.object(fl.FlowCurveBias, "observe", mutant) if mutant else mock.MagicMock()
+    with ctx:
+        for m, c in seq:
+            b.observe(m, c)
+    return b
+
+SEQ = [(27.0, 25.0)] * fl.FLOW_BIAS_MIN_SAMPLES + [(31.0, 25.0)] * 5
+WARM = SEQ[: fl.FLOW_BIAS_MIN_SAMPLES]
+base = run(SEQ).bias_k
+nb = run(WARM).bias_k
+with mock.patch.object(fl, "FLOW_BIAS_ALPHA", 0.2):
+    mut = run(SEQ).bias_k
+    nm = run(WARM).bias_k
+print(f"RESULT bias_baseline={base:.6f} K")
+print(f"RESULT bias_mutant={mut:.6f} K")
+print(f"RESULT delta={mut - base:.6f} K")
+print(f"RESULT null_delta={nm - nb} K")

@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Metric: how many FeeRule objects grid_fee.parse_rules returns for the rules text "0.5" (a rate with no '=' part),
+#   and the config-flow verdict grid_fee.spec_problem gives it. Baseline raises GridFeeError (-1 rules, 'invalid_grid_fee_rules').
+# Command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_121362d4.py
+# EXPECTED RESULT rules_baseline=-1 count  (GridFeeError raised; -1 stands for the raise)
+# EXPECTED RESULT rules_mutant=1 count  (the bare "0.5" parses as one rule: rate 0.5, applies always)
+# EXPECTED RESULT rules_delta=2 count
+# EXPECTED RESULT verdict_baseline=invalid_grid_fee_rules
+# EXPECTED RESULT verdict_mutant=None  (config flow would accept the text)
+# EXPECTED RESULT null_delta=0 count  (well-formed "Mon-Fri = 0.25": same rules either arm)
+# EXPECTED RESULT reach_calls_without_eq=2 count  (production entry points that hand _parse_rule a line with no '=')
+# Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-rem (4 vCPU Xeon @ 2.10GHz).
+# Instrumented symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.grid_fee:_parse_rule (line 173 guard `    if not sep:`),
+#   reached through parse_rules (grid_fee.py:226), spec_problem (:242, config_flow.py:3927) and GridFeeSchedule.from_config (:287).
+# Perturbation: GUARD_OFF `    if not sep:` -> `    if False:` applied in memory (function recompiled from its own source,
+#   patched onto the module for the mutant arm only). Direction: rules parsed 0 (raise) -> 1; spec_problem 'invalid' -> None.
+# Null control: a line with '=' where the guard is false either way; baseline and mutant parse identically.
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import inspect, sys, textwrap
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest import mock
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer import grid_fee as gf  # noqa: E402
+
+OLD = "    if not sep:"
+NEW = "    if False:"
+
+
+def mutant_fn():
+    src = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(gf._parse_rule))
+    old = textwrap.dedent(OLD + "\n    pass").splitlines()[0]
+    assert src.count(old) == 1, "anchor line moved"
+    src = src.replace(old, textwrap.dedent(NEW + "\n    pass").splitlines()[0], 1)
+    ns = dict(gf.__dict__)
+    exec(compile(src, gf.__file__, "exec"), ns)
+    return ns["_parse_rule"]
+
+
+def n_rules(spec):
+    try:
+        return len(gf.parse_rules(spec))
+    except gf.GridFeeError:
+        return -1
+
+
+mut = mutant_fn()
+bad, good = "0.5", "Mon-Fri = 0.25"
+rb, vb, gb = n_rules(bad), gf.spec_problem(bad), n_rules(good)
+with mock.patch.object(gf, "_parse_rule", mut):
+    rm, vm, gm = n_rules(bad), gf.spec_problem(bad), n_rules(good)
+
+# Reach: spy on _parse_rule; production entry points fed a text with no '='.
+seen = []
+real = gf._parse_rule
+
+
+def spy(line):
+    seen.append("=" not in line)
+    return real(line)
+
+
+with mock.patch.object(gf, "_parse_rule", spy):
+    gf.spec_problem(bad)  # config_flow.py:3927 path
+    gf.GridFeeSchedule.from_config({"grid_fee_mode": gf.MODE_RULES, "grid_fee_rules": bad})  # store path
+print(f"RESULT rules_baseline={rb} count")
+print(f"RESULT rules_mutant={rm} count")
+print(f"RESULT rules_delta={rm - rb} count")
+print(f"RESULT verdict_baseline={vb}")
+print(f"RESULT verdict_mutant={vm}")
+print(f"RESULT null_delta={abs(gm - gb)} count")
+print(f"RESULT reach_calls_without_eq={sum(seen)} count")

@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Metric: heat (kW, q_rad + q_floor) that thermal_model._valve_two_zone_delivery lets the single-tank buffer
+#   discharge into the emitters on one 0.25 h step when the pump makes 0 kW and the tank holds almost no heat.
+# Command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_22b5ec87.py
+# EXPECTED RESULT delivered_baseline=0.278400 kW  (capped at the energy the tank can give: tank-bound)
+# EXPECTED RESULT delivered_mutant=2.800000 kW  (cap vanishes: 1e-6 h divisor makes `available` huge, no scaling)
+# EXPECTED RESULT delta=2.521600 kW
+# EXPECTED RESULT null_delta=0.0 kW  (tank hot and large: drawn <= available in both arms, edit inert)
+# EXPECTED RESULT reach_valve_calls=64 count  (calls of _valve_two_zone_delivery with two_tank False, driven
+#   through the public ThermalModel.simulate_step on a two-zone throttled-valve parameter set)
+# Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-rem (4 vCPU Xeon @ 2.10GHz).
+# Instrumented symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.thermal_model:_valve_two_zone_delivery, line 2593
+#   (the single-tank `else:` branch's `available = thermal_power - q_buf_loss + c_buf*max(0, T_buf-floor)/max(dt_hours,1e-6)`),
+#   called from thermal_model.py:3963 inside _simulate_step_two_zone.
+# Perturbation: key 22b5ec8775d5bd50, line 2593 `) / max(dt_hours, 1e-6)` -> `) / min(dt_hours, 1e-6)`, applied in
+#   memory to the third such line of the function (the one after `available = `). Direction: delivered up.
+# Null control: a 300 L tank at 60 C, where available >> drawn and no scaling happens in either arm.
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import dataclasses, inspect, sys, textwrap
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest import mock
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer import mixing_valve, thermal_model as tm  # noqa: E402
+
+fn = tm._valve_two_zone_delivery
+src = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(fn))
+anchor = "        available = thermal_power - q_buf_loss + c_buf * max(\n            0.0, T_buf - floor_temp\n        ) / max(dt_hours, 1e-6)"
+assert src.count(anchor) == 1, "anchor moved"
+src = src.replace(anchor, anchor.replace("/ max(dt_hours, 1e-6)", "/ min(dt_hours, 1e-6)"), 1)
+ns = dict(tm.__dict__)
+exec(compile(src, tm.__file__, "exec"), ns)
+mut = ns["_valve_two_zone_delivery"]
+
+
+def drive(fn_, volume, t_buf):
+    p = dataclasses.replace(tm.ThermalParameters(), mixing_valve_mode=mixing_valve.MODE_MANUAL,
+                            mixing_valve_target=35.0, buffer_tank_volume=volume)
+    st = tm.ThermalState(buffer_tank_temperature=t_buf, upper_floor_temperature=21.0, slab_temperature=22.0)
+    qr, qf, *_ = fn_(p, st, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 35.0, -10.0, 0.2, 0.25, False)
+    return qr + qf
+
+
+base = drive(fn, 20.0, 24.0)
+m = drive(mut, 20.0, 24.0)
+null_delta = abs(drive(fn, 300.0, 60.0) - drive(mut, 300.0, 60.0))
+
+calls = []
+real = tm._valve_two_zone_delivery
+
+
+def spy(*a, **k):
+    calls.append(a[-1])
+    return real(*a, **k)
+
+
+p = dataclasses.replace(tm.ThermalParameters(), two_zone_enabled=True, mixing_valve_mode=mixing_valve.MODE_MANUAL, mixing_valve_target=35.0)
+model = tm.ThermalModel(p)
+with mock.patch.object(tm, "_valve_two_zone_delivery", spy):
+    s = tm.ThermalState(buffer_tank_temperature=30.0)
+    for _ in range(8):
+        s = model.simulate_step(s, 0.0, -5.0, dt_hours=0.25)
+print(f"RESULT delivered_baseline={base:.6f} kW")
+print(f"RESULT delivered_mutant={m:.6f} kW")
+print(f"RESULT delta={m - base:.6f} kW")
+print(f"RESULT null_delta={null_delta} kW")
+print(f"RESULT reach_valve_calls={len(calls)} count")
+print(f"RESULT reach_valve_calls_single_tank={sum(1 for c in calls if not c)} count")
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_2719aef4.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_2719aef4.py

index 0000000000..05c44e3167
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_2719aef4.py
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Metric: PriceShapeModel.expected_daily_min(day_types=[0], level=0.0) on a fully trusted model (shapes min 1.0):
+#   baseline None ("no opinion"), and how many production call sites can pass level<=0.
+# Command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_2719aef4.py
+# EXPECTED RESULT min_baseline=None
+# EXPECTED RESULT min_mutant=0.0  (level 0 scaled by min shape 1.0: a zero price ceiling instead of "no opinion")
+# EXPECTED RESULT mutant_is_not_none=1 count
+# EXPECTED RESULT null_delta=0.0  (level=0.3 and level=-0.2/negative boundary: -0.2 -> None both arms; 0.3 -> 0.3 both arms)
+# EXPECTED RESULT reach_callers_total=1 count  (coordinator.py is the only caller of expected_daily_min)
+# EXPECTED RESULT reach_caller_guard_level_gt_1e6=1 count  (that caller only calls when `level > 1e-6`, so level==0.0 never arrives)
+# Baseline: 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692. Machine: box D3-rem (4 vCPU Xeon @ 2.10GHz).
+# Instrumented symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.price_model:PriceShapeModel.expected_daily_min
+#   (line 337 `        if not day_types or not np.isfinite(level) or level <= 0.0:`), caller coordinator.py:4361-4377.
+# Perturbation: `level <= 0.0` -> `level < 0.0` applied in memory (method recompiled from its own source,
+#   attached with mock.patch.object for the mutant arm). Direction: result None -> 0.0 at level == 0.0 only.
+#   In production the sole caller is guarded by `if level > 1e-6` (coordinator.py:4370), so the boundary is
+#   unreachable there: equivalent at the integration level, separable only by a direct unit call.
+# Null control: level 0.3 (above the boundary) and level -0.2 (below it): same result both arms.
+import os
+for _v in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS"):
+    os.environ.setdefault(_v, "1")
+import inspect, re, sys, textwrap
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest import mock
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+from custom_components.heatpump_optimizer import price_model as pm  # noqa: E402
+
+OLD = "        if not day_types or not np.isfinite(level) or level <= 0.0:"
+NEW = "        if not day_types or not np.isfinite(level) or level < 0.0:"
+M = pm.PriceShapeModel
+
+
+def mutant_fn():
+    src = textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(M.expected_daily_min))
+    old = textwrap.dedent(OLD + "\n    pass").splitlines()[0]
+    assert src.count(old) == 1, "anchor line moved"
+    src = src.replace(old, textwrap.dedent(NEW + "\n    pass").splitlines()[0], 1)
+    ns = dict(pm.__dict__)
+    exec(compile(src, pm.__file__, "exec"), ns)
+    return ns["expected_daily_min"]
+
+
+model = M(days=[pm.SHAPE_CONFIDENCE_DAYS, pm.SHAPE_CONFIDENCE_DAYS])
+levels = (0.0, 0.3, -0.2)
+base = {lv: model.expected_daily_min([0], lv) for lv in levels}
+with mock.patch.object(M, "expected_daily_min", mutant_fn()):
+    mut = {lv: model.expected_daily_min([0], lv) for lv in levels}
+null_delta = max(abs(mut[lv] - base[lv]) if base[lv] is not None and mut[lv] is not None
+                 else float(base[lv] is not mut[lv]) for lv in (0.3, -0.2))
+
+pkg = ROOT / "custom_components" / "heatpump_optimizer"
+callers = [p.name for p in pkg.glob("*.py") if p.name != "price_model.py"
+           and re.search(r"\.expected_daily_min\(", p.read_text())]
+coord = (pkg / "coordinator.py").read_text()
+i = coord.index("self._price_model.expected_daily_min(")
+guard = "if level > 1e-6:" in coord[max(0, i - 400):i]
+print(f"RESULT min_baseline={base[0.0]}")
+print(f"RESULT min_mutant={mut[0.0]}")
+print(f"RESULT mutant_is_not_none={int(mut[0.0] is not None)} count")
+print(f"RESULT null_delta={null_delta}")
+print(f"RESULT reach_callers_total={len(callers)} count")
+print(f"RESULT reach_caller_guard_level_gt_1e6={int(guard)} count")
diff --git a/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_3885e472.py b/dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/probe_3885e472.py
